# Figure specifications
```{r fig}
journal_theme <- function(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") {ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
                                                                            ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
                                                                                           plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           strip.placement = "outside",
                                                                                           strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.9, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 4)),
                                                                                           strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.9),
                                                                                           panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
                                                                                           legend.position = "bottom",
                                                                                           legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                                           legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = base_size, colour = "black"),
                                                                                           plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))}


journal_theme_no_text <- function() {ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    axis.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    axis.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.3, colour = "black"),
                                                    axis.ticks.length = unit(1.2, "mm"),
                                                    strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    legend.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                    legend.position = "bottom")}

figure_width_mm <- 150
figure_height_mm <- 170
figure_dpi <- 300

journal_save <- function(filename, plot, width_mm, height_mm, dpi = 300) {filename <- file.path(dirname(filename), paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename)), ".tiff"))

                                                                          if (!dir.exists(dirname(filename))) {dir.create(dirname(filename), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)}

                                                                          tryCatch({ggplot2::ggsave(filename = filename,
                                                                                          plot = plot,
                                                                                          width = width_mm,
                                                                                          height = height_mm,
                                                                                          units = "mm",
                                                                                          dpi = dpi,
                                                                                          device = "tiff",
                                                                                          bg = "white",
                                                                                          compression = "lzw",
                                                                                          limitsize = FALSE)},
                                                                                   finally = {grDevices::graphics.off()
                                                                                              gc()})
                                                                          
                                                                          invisible(filename)}
```

# Covariate figure
```{r covariate figure}
layer_titles <- c(Population = "Population count",
                  Malaria = "Plasmodium falciparum incidence (per 1,000 population)",
                  Urbanization = "Degree of urbanization",
                  Consanguinity = "Consanguinity (%)",
                  EFI = "Ethnic Fractionalization Index",
                  RDI = "Religious Diversity Index",
                  Counselling = "Counselling availability",
                  Prevention = "Prevention program availability")

world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

add_legend <- function(show_text = TRUE) {if (!show_text) {return(patchwork::plot_spacer())}
                                          ggplot() +
                                          annotate("rect",
                                                   xmin = 0.00, xmax = 0.07,
                                                   ymin = 0.45, ymax = 0.70,
                                                   fill = "#000000") +
                                          annotate("text",
                                                   x = 0.09, y = 0.575,
                                                   label = "Unavailable",
                                                   hjust = 0,
                                                   size = 3.5,
                                                   family = "Times New Roman") +
                                          annotate("rect",
                                                   xmin = 0.30, xmax = 0.37,
                                                   ymin = 0.45, ymax = 0.70,
                                                   fill = "#B42152") +
                                          annotate("text",
                                                   x = 0.39, y = 0.575,
                                                   label = "Available regionally",
                                                   hjust = 0,
                                                   size = 3.5,
                                                   family = "Times New Roman") +
                                          annotate("rect",
                                                   xmin = 0.68, xmax = 0.75,
                                                   ymin = 0.45, ymax = 0.70,
                                                   fill = "#F7C5A5") +
                                          annotate("text",
                                                   x = 0.77, y = 0.575,
                                                   label = "Available nationally",
                                                   hjust = 0,
                                                   size = 3.5,
                                                   family = "Times New Roman") +
                                          coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.08), ylim = c(0, 1), expand = FALSE) +
                                          theme_void(base_family = "Times New Roman") +
                                          theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "mm"))}

plot_continuous_raster <- function(raster_layer,
                                   layer_name,
                                   transform = "none",
                                   legend_labels = c("Low", "High"),
                                   show_text = TRUE,
                                   disc_legend = FALSE) {r_df <- as.data.frame(raster_layer, xy = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)
                                                         names(r_df) <- c("x", "y", "value")
                                                                   
                                                         if (disc_legend) {r_df$plot_value <- r_df$value
                                                                   
                                                                           fill_scale <- scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("black", "#B42152", "#F7C5A5"),
                                                                                                              name = NULL,
                                                                                                              na.value = "white",
                                                                                                              guide = "none")} 
                                                                   
                                                         else {r_df$plot_value <- dplyr::case_when(transform == "log1p" ~ log1p(r_df$value),
                                                                                                   transform == "sqrt"  ~ sqrt(r_df$value),
                                                                                                   TRUE                 ~ r_df$value)
                                                         
                                                         vmin <- min(r_df$plot_value, na.rm = TRUE)
                                                         vmax <- max(r_df$plot_value, na.rm = TRUE)
                                                         
                                                         fill_scale <- scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "F",
                                                                                            direction = -1,
                                                                                            end = 0.9,
                                                                                            limits = c(vmin, vmax),
                                                                                            breaks = c(vmin, vmax),
                                                                                            labels = legend_labels,
                                                                                            name = NULL,
                                                                                            na.value = "white",
                                                                                            guide = guide_colorbar(title = NULL,
                                                                                                                   direction = "horizontal",
                                                                                                                   barwidth = unit(25, "mm"),
                                                                                                                   barheight = unit(4, "mm"),
                                                                                                                   ticks = FALSE))}
                                                         
                                                         base_plot <- ggplot() +
                                                                      geom_raster(data = r_df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = plot_value)) +
                                                                      geom_sf(data = world, fill = NA, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.15) +
                                                                      coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-60, 85), expand = FALSE) +
                                                                      fill_scale +
                                                                      labs(title = stringr::str_replace(layer_name, "Plasmodium falciparum", "<i>Plasmodium falciparum</i>"),
                                                                           x = NULL,
                                                                           y = NULL) +
                                                                      theme_void(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
                                                                      theme(plot.title = if (show_text) {ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, face = "bold", colour = "black", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 3))} else {element_blank()},
                                                                            legend.position = if (show_text && !disc_legend) "bottom" else "none",
                                                                            legend.title = element_blank(),
                                                                            legend.text = if (show_text) element_text(size = 10) else element_blank(),
                                                                            plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"))
                                                         
                                                         if (disc_legend && show_text) {base_plot / (patchwork::plot_spacer() + 
                                                                                                     add_legend() + 
                                                                                                     patchwork::plot_spacer() +
                                                                                                     patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.75, 1, 0.75))) +
                                                                                                     patchwork::plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.06))} else {base_plot}}

Plots_continuous <- lapply(c("Population",
                             "Malaria",
                             "Urbanization",
                             "Consanguinity",
                             "EFI",
                             "RDI",
                             "Counselling",
                             "Prevention"),
                           
                           function(layer) {if (!layer %in% names(Covariates)) {stop("Layer not found in Covariates: ", layer)}
                                            message("Plotting continuous layer: ", layer)
                             
                                            plot_continuous_raster(raster_layer = Covariates[[layer]],
                                                                   layer_name = layer_titles[[layer]],
                                                                   transform = ifelse(layer %in% c("Population", "RDI"), "log1p", "none"),
                                                                   legend_labels = c("Low", "High"),
                                                                   disc_legend = layer %in% c("Counselling", "Prevention"))})

names(Plots_continuous) <- c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization", "Consanguinity", "EFI", "RDI", "Counselling", "Prevention")

covariate_figure_dir <- "Output/Covariates"

if (!dir.exists(covariate_figure_dir)) {dir.create(covariate_figure_dir, recursive = TRUE)}

figure_width_mm  <- 300
figure_height_mm <- 150
figure_dpi       <- 300

theme_no_text <- theme_void(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
                 theme(plot.title = element_blank(),
                       axis.title.x = element_blank(),
                       axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                       axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                       axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                       strip.text.x = element_blank(),
                       strip.text.y = element_blank(),
                       legend.title = element_blank(),
                       legend.text = element_blank(),
                       legend.position = "bottom",
                       plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "mm"))

save_covariate_tiff_versions <- function(plot,
                                         layer,
                                         output_dir = covariate_figure_dir,
                                         width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                         height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                         dpi = figure_dpi) {layer_safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", layer)
                                         
                                                            plot_with_text <- plot_continuous_raster(raster_layer = Covariates[[layer]],
                                                                                                     layer_name = layer_titles[[layer]],
                                                                                                     transform = ifelse(layer %in% c("Population", "RDI"), "log1p", "none"),
                                                                                                     legend_labels = c("Low", "High"),
                                                                                                     disc_legend = layer %in% c("Counselling", "Prevention"),
                                                                                                     show_text = TRUE)
                                                            
                                                            plot_no_text <- plot_continuous_raster(raster_layer = Covariates[[layer]],
                                                                                                   layer_name = layer_titles[[layer]],
                                                                                                   transform = ifelse(layer %in% c("Population", "RDI"), "log1p", "none"),
                                                                                                   legend_labels = c("Low", "High"),
                                                                                                   disc_legend = layer %in% c("Counselling", "Prevention"),
                                                                                                   show_text = FALSE)
                                                            
                                                            file_with_text <- file.path(output_dir,
                                                                                        paste0(layer_safe, "_with_text.tiff"))
                                                            
                                                            file_no_text <- file.path(output_dir,
                                                                                      paste0(layer_safe, "_no_text.tiff"))
                                                            
                                                            ggplot2::ggsave(filename = file_with_text,
                                                                            plot = plot_with_text,
                                                                            device = "tiff",
                                                                            width = width_mm,
                                                                            height = height_mm,
                                                                            units = "mm",
                                                                            dpi = dpi,
                                                                            bg = "white",
                                                                            compression = "lzw",
                                                                            limitsize = FALSE)
                                                            
                                                            ggplot2::ggsave(filename = file_no_text,
                                                                            plot = plot_no_text,
                                                                            device = "tiff",
                                                                            width = width_mm,
                                                                            height = height_mm,
                                                                            units = "mm",
                                                                            dpi = dpi,
                                                                            bg = "white",
                                                                            compression = "lzw",
                                                                            limitsize = FALSE)
                                                            
                                                            list(layer = layer,
                                                                 with_text = plot_with_text,
                                                                 no_text = plot_no_text,
                                                                 files = list(with_text = file_with_text,
                                                                              no_text = file_no_text))}

Figure_exports <- purrr::imap(Plots_continuous,
                              function(plot, layer) {message("Exporting TIFF versions for: ", layer)
                                                     save_covariate_tiff_versions(plot = plot,
                                                                                  layer = layer,
                                                                                  output_dir = covariate_figure_dir)})

rm(Plots_continuous, theme_no_text, world, Figure_exports, layer_titles, covariate_figure_dir, plot_continuous_raster, save_covariate_tiff_versions, add_legend)
```

# Retain variable of interest
```{r filter}
Data <- Data %>%
        filter(measure_name == "Carrier prevalence"  & metric_name == "percent" & cause_name == "Beta Thalassaemia" & !is.na(sample_size) & sample_size >= 50) %>%
        mutate(count = as.numeric(count),
               value = as.numeric(value),
               sample_size = as.numeric(round(sample_size)),
               sample_size_comment = ifelse(is.na(sample_size_comment), "NULL", sample_size_comment),
               multi = ifelse(is.na(MultiLocation), "No", MultiLocation)) %>% 
        dplyr::select(-metric_name, -diagnostic_method, -nationality_comment,
                      -sex_group_name, -age_group_name, -n_female, -n_male, -score, -end_year_assumed, -comments,
                      -ithaID, -locus, -globin_phenotype, -comment, -start_year, -measure_name, -cause_name, 
                      -name, -region_comment, -min_age, -max_age, -entry_id, -id) %>%
       rename("total" = sample_size,
              "year" = end_year,
              "max" = MaxADM,
              "recalculate" = RecalculateDetails) %>%
       distinct()
```

# Add geometries to data
```{r geometry}
gpkg_dir <- "Input"

ADM0_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM0.gpkg")
ADM1_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM1.gpkg")
ADM2_gpkg <- file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM2.gpkg")

sf_use_s2(FALSE)
ADM0_shapes <- st_read(ADM0_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(name, geo_admin0, geom) %>%
               rename(geo0 = geom,
                      ADM0 = name) %>%
               mutate(Area = as.numeric(set_units(st_area(geo0), "km^2")))
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

ADM1_shapes <- st_read(ADM1_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(name, geo_admin1, geom) %>%
               rename(geo1 = geom,
                      ADM1 = name)

ADM2_shapes <- st_read(ADM2_gpkg, quiet = TRUE) %>%
               dplyr::select(name, geo_admin2, geom) %>%
               rename(geo2 = geom,
                      ADM2 = name)

add_geometries <- function(df) {ADM0 <- df %>%
                                        dplyr::select(geo_admin0) %>%
                                        distinct() %>%
                                        filter(geo_admin0 != ":", !is.na(geo_admin0)) %>%
                                        left_join(ADM0_shapes, by = "geo_admin0") %>%
                                        distinct()

                                ADM1 <- df %>%
                                        dplyr::select(geo_admin1) %>%
                                        distinct() %>%
                                        filter(geo_admin1 != ":", !is.na(geo_admin1)) %>%
                                        left_join(ADM1_shapes, by = "geo_admin1") %>%
                                        distinct()

                                ADM2 <- df %>%
                                        dplyr::select(geo_admin2) %>%
                                        distinct() %>%
                                        filter(geo_admin2 != ":", !is.na(geo_admin2)) %>%
                                        left_join(ADM2_shapes, by = "geo_admin2") %>%
                                        distinct()

                                df %>%
                                left_join(ADM0, by = "geo_admin0") %>%
                                left_join(ADM1, by = "geo_admin1") %>%
                                left_join(ADM2, by = "geo_admin2") %>%
                                distinct()}

Data <- add_geometries(Data)

rm(add_geometries, ADM0_gpkg, ADM1_gpkg, ADM2_gpkg)
```

# Round coordinates
Coordinates were treated as non-distinct if they matched after rounding longitude and latitude to 4 decimal places, corresponding approximately to an 11 m latitude precision and a longitude precision ranging from ~11 m at the equator to smaller distances at higher latitudes.
```{r rounding}
Data$latitude <- round(Data$latitude, 4)
Data$longitude <- round(Data$longitude, 4)
```

# Function for selecting 1 value per overlapping coordinate set
```{r prioritization}
prioritize <- function(Data, prefer_original = FALSE) {priority <- Data %>%
                                                                   group_by(longitude, latitude)

                                                       # 0. Prefer original records over disaggregated records, where available
                                                       if (isTRUE(prefer_original) && "origin_disaggregation" %in% names(priority)) {priority <- priority %>%
                                                                                                                                                 filter(n() == 1 | 
                                                                                                                                                        all(origin_disaggregation != "Original", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                                                                                                        origin_disaggregation == "Original")}

                                                       priority <- priority %>%
                                                                   # 1. Prefer non-multilocation entries
                                                                   filter(n() == 1 |
                                                                          all(multi == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                          all(multi == "No", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                          multi == "No") %>%
                                                         
                                                                   # 2. Prefer non-Hardy-Weinberg entries
                                                                   filter(n() == 1 |
                                                                          all(recalculate == "C", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                          all(recalculate != "C", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                          recalculate != "C") %>%
                                                         
                                                                   # 3. Prefer low bias entries
                                                                   filter(n() == 1 |
                                                                          all(bias_flag == "Low", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                          all(bias_flag != "Low", na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                          bias_flag == "Low") %>%
                                                         
                                                                  # 4. Prefer non-ethnicity entries unless specific ethnicity has >= 2x sample size
                                                                  mutate(broad_ethnicity = ethnicity_name %in% c("NULL", "Mixed/Multiple"),
                                                                         total_broad_ethnicity = sum(total[broad_ethnicity], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                         total_specific_ethnicity = sum(total[!broad_ethnicity], na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                         keep_specific_ethnicity = total_specific_ethnicity >= 2 * total_broad_ethnicity) %>%
                                                                  filter(n() == 1 |
                                                                         all(broad_ethnicity, na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                         all(!broad_ethnicity, na.rm = TRUE) |
                                                                         broad_ethnicity | (!broad_ethnicity & keep_specific_ethnicity)) %>%
                                                         
                                                                  # 5. Calculate max year, max total, second max total
                                                                  mutate(max_Year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                         max_Total = max(total, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                         second_max_Total = {totals <- sort(unique(total[!is.na(total)]), decreasing = TRUE)
                                                                         
                                                                                             if (length(totals) >= 2) totals[2] else NA_real_},
                                                                         keep = ifelse(is.na(second_max_Total), TRUE, max_Total >= 2 * second_max_Total)) %>%
                                                         
                                                                  # 6. If max total is at least double second max total, keep max total; otherwise keep latest year
                                                                  filter(n() == 1 |
                                                                         (keep & total == max_Total) |
                                                                         (!keep & year == max_Year)) %>%
                                                         
                                                                  # 7. If still tied, choose largest total
                                                                  filter(total == max(total, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                                                         
                                                                  # 8. If still tied, keep first row
                                                                  slice(1) %>%
                                                                  ungroup() %>%
                                                                  dplyr::select(-broad_ethnicity, -total_broad_ethnicity, -total_specific_ethnicity,
                                                                                -keep_specific_ethnicity, -max_Year,-max_Total, -second_max_Total, -keep)
                                                       
                                                       return(priority)}
```

# Function for removing extremely geographically isolated datapoints
```{r isolate}
isolate <- function(df, distance_threshold = 25) {# Obtain coordinates
                                                  df <-  st_as_sf(df,
                                                                  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                                                                  crs = 4326,
                                                                 remove = FALSE)
                                        
                                                  if (nrow(df) < 3) {df$geographic_isolate_removed <- FALSE
                                                                     df$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                                     df$dbscan_noise_removed <- FALSE
                                                                     return(df)}
                     
                                                                     coords <- sf::st_coordinates(df)
                                                                     valid_coord_rows <- stats::complete.cases(coords)
                                                                     df_valid <- df[valid_coord_rows, ]
                                        
                                                  if (nrow(df_valid) < 3) {df_valid$geographic_isolate_removed <- FALSE
                                                                           df_valid$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                                           df_valid$dbscan_noise_removed <- FALSE
                                                                           return(df_valid)}
                                        
                                                  # Remove geographic isolates based on nearest-neighbor distance
                                                  coords_valid <- sf::st_coordinates(df_valid)
                                                  nearest_distance <- apply(as.matrix(stats::dist(coords_valid)), 1, function(row) min(row[row > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
                                                  keep_geographic <- nearest_distance <= distance_threshold
                                        
                                                  df_geo_clean <- df_valid[keep_geographic, ]}
```

# Function for spatial density clustering
```{r geonoise}
cluster_legend_one_line <- function(p, n_clusters) {cluster_levels <- as.character(seq_len(n_clusters))
                                                    cluster_cols <- viridisLite::rocket(n_clusters)
                                                    cluster_shapes <- c(16, 17, 18, 15, 25, 7, 8, 23, 3, 4)
                                                    cluster_shapes <- rep(cluster_shapes, length.out = n_clusters)
                                                    
                                                    p +
                                                    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(name = NULL, values = stats::setNames(cluster_cols, cluster_levels)) +
                                                    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(name = NULL, values = stats::setNames(cluster_shapes, cluster_levels)) +
                                                    ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE, override.aes = list(shape = cluster_shapes, size = 3, alpha = 1, fill = cluster_cols)),
                                                                    shape = "none",
                                                                    fill = "none",
                                                                    linetype = "none",
                                                                    alpha = "none") +
                                                    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                                                                   legend.direction = "horizontal",
                                                                   legend.box = "horizontal",
                                                                   legend.box.just = "center",
                                                                   legend.key.width = grid::unit(5, "mm"),
                                                                   legend.key.height = grid::unit(5, "mm"),
                                                                   legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(1.5, "mm"),
                                                                   legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
                                                                   legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0))}

geonoise <- function(df,
                     dataset_name = NULL,
                     k = 2,
                     epsilon_quantile = 0.95,
                     epsilon_upper_quantile = 0.98,
                     extent_fraction = 0.02,
                     minPts_multiplier = 0.75,
                     minPts_floor = 4,
                     output_dir = "Output/Cluster/",
                     export_plots = TRUE) {if (is.null(dataset_name)) {dataset_name <- deparse(substitute(df))}
  
                                           df_name <- paste(dataset_name, collapse = "")
                                           df_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_", df_name)
                                           
                                           # Obtain coordinates
                                           df <- sf::st_as_sf(df, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
                                           
                                           if (nrow(df) < 3) {df$geographic_isolate_removed <- FALSE
                                                              df$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                              df$dbscan_noise_removed <- FALSE
                                                              return(df)}
                                           
                                           coords <- sf::st_coordinates(df)
                                           valid_coord_rows <- stats::complete.cases(coords)
                                           df_geo_clean <- df[valid_coord_rows, ]
                                           
                                           if (nrow(df_geo_clean) < 5) {df_geo_clean$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                                        df_geo_clean$dbscan_noise_removed <- FALSE
                                                                        return(df_geo_clean)}
                                           
                                           coords_dbscan <- sf::st_coordinates(df_geo_clean)
                                           valid_dbscan_rows <- stats::complete.cases(coords_dbscan)
                                           df_dbscan_valid <- df_geo_clean[valid_dbscan_rows, ]
                                           
                                           if (nrow(df_dbscan_valid) < 5) {df_dbscan_valid$Cluster <- NA_integer_
                                                                           return(df_dbscan_valid)}
                                           
                                           coords_dbscan_valid <- sf::st_coordinates(df_dbscan_valid)
                                           
                                           # Estimate adaptive epsilon
                                           knn_dist <- dbscan::kNNdist(coords_dbscan_valid, k = k)
                                           Optimal_epsilon <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(knn_dist, epsilon_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
                                           
                                           # Constrain epsilon
                                           data_extent <- max(apply(coords_dbscan_valid, 2, max, na.rm = TRUE) - apply(coords_dbscan_valid, 2, min, na.rm = TRUE))
                                           eps_lower_limit <- data_extent * extent_fraction
                                           eps_upper_limit <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(knn_dist, epsilon_upper_quantile, na.rm = TRUE))
                                           
                                           Optimal_epsilon <- max(min(Optimal_epsilon, eps_upper_limit), eps_lower_limit)
                                           
                                           # Adaptive minPts
                                           adaptive_minPts <- max(round(log(nrow(df_dbscan_valid)) * minPts_multiplier), minPts_floor)
                                           
                                           # Run DBSCAN
                                           DBSCAN_result <- dbscan::dbscan(coords_dbscan_valid, eps = Optimal_epsilon, minPts = adaptive_minPts)
                                           
                                           df_dbscan_valid$Cluster <- DBSCAN_result$cluster
                                           
                                           # k-NN plot
                                           knn_df <- tibble::tibble(Index = seq_along(knn_dist), kNN_distance = sort(knn_dist))
                                           
                                           knn_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(knn_df, ggplot2::aes(x = Index, y = kNN_distance)) +
                                                       ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
                                                       ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = Optimal_epsilon,
                                                                           colour = "#BE1D54",
                                                                           linetype = 2) +
                                                       journal_theme() +
                                                       ggplot2::labs(x = "Points sorted by distance",
                                                                     y = "k-NN distance")
                                           
                                           knn_plot_no_text <- knn_plot +
                                                               journal_theme_no_text() +
                                                               ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
                                           
                                           #  Cluster plot
                                           cluster_df <- tibble::tibble(X = coords_dbscan_valid[, 1],
                                                                        Y = coords_dbscan_valid[, 2],
                                                                        Cluster = DBSCAN_result$cluster) %>%
                                                         dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = dplyr::if_else(Cluster == 0, "Noise", paste0("Cluster ", Cluster)))
                                           
                                           cluster_points_df <- cluster_df %>%
                                                                dplyr::filter(Cluster != 0)
                                           
                                           noise_points_df <- cluster_df %>%
                                                              dplyr::filter(Cluster == 0)
                                           
                                           cluster_ids <- sort(unique(cluster_points_df$Cluster))
                                           cluster_labels <- paste0("Cluster ", cluster_ids)
                                           legend_labels <- c(cluster_labels, "Noise")
                                           n_clusters <- length(cluster_ids)
                                           cluster_cols <- viridisLite::rocket(n_clusters)
                                           names(cluster_cols) <- cluster_labels
                                           
                                           legend_cols <- c(cluster_cols, Noise = "black")
                                           cluster_shapes <- c(1, 17, 15, 3, 4, 8, 7, 18, 0, 2, 5, 6, 10, 12)
                                           cluster_shapes <- rep(cluster_shapes, length.out = n_clusters)
                                           names(cluster_shapes) <- cluster_labels
                                           legend_shapes <- c(cluster_shapes, Noise = 16)
                                           
                                           cluster_df <- cluster_df %>%
                                                         dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = factor(Cluster_label, levels = legend_labels))
                                           
                                           cluster_points_df <- cluster_points_df %>%
                                                                dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = factor(paste0("Cluster ", Cluster), levels = legend_labels))
                                           
                                           noise_points_df <- noise_points_df %>%
                                                              dplyr::mutate(Cluster_label = factor("Noise", levels = legend_labels))
                                           
                                           hull_df <- cluster_points_df %>%
                                                      dplyr::group_by(Cluster_label) %>%
                                                      dplyr::filter(dplyr::n() >= 3) %>%
                                                      dplyr::slice(chull(X, Y)) %>%
                                                      dplyr::ungroup()
                                           
                                           cluster_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
                                                           ggplot2::geom_polygon(data = hull_df,
                                                                                 ggplot2::aes(x = X,
                                                                                              y = Y,
                                                                                              group = Cluster_label,
                                                                                              colour = Cluster_label,
                                                                                              fill = Cluster_label),
                                                                                 alpha = 0.14,
                                                                                 linewidth = 0.5,
                                                                                 show.legend = FALSE) +
                                                           ggplot2::geom_point(data = cluster_points_df,
                                                                               ggplot2::aes(x = X,
                                                                                            y = Y,
                                                                                            colour = Cluster_label,
                                                                                            shape = Cluster_label),
                                                                               size = 2,
                                                                               stroke = 0.7,
                                                                               show.legend = TRUE) +
                                                           ggplot2::geom_point(data = noise_points_df,
                                                                               ggplot2::aes(x = X,
                                                                                            y = Y,
                                                                                            colour = Cluster_label,
                                                                                            shape = Cluster_label),
                                                                               size = 2,
                                                                               stroke = 0.7,
                                                                               show.legend = TRUE) +
                                                           ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(name = NULL,
                                                                                        values = legend_cols,
                                                                                        breaks = legend_labels,
                                                                                        labels = legend_labels,
                                                                                        drop = FALSE) +
                                                           ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(name = NULL,
                                                                                       values = legend_shapes,
                                                                                       breaks = legend_labels,
                                                                                       labels = legend_labels,
                                                                                       drop = FALSE) +
                                                           ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols,
                                                                                      breaks = cluster_labels,
                                                                                      guide = "none") +
                                                           ggplot2::guides(colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(nrow = 2,
                                                                                                          byrow = TRUE,
                                                                                                          override.aes = list(shape = unname(legend_shapes),
                                                                                                                              size = 3,
                                                                                                                              stroke = 0.7,
                                                                                                                              alpha = 1)),
                                                                           shape = "none",
                                                                           fill = "none") +
                                                           journal_theme() +
                                                           ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                                                                          legend.direction = "horizontal",
                                                                          legend.box = "horizontal",
                                                                          legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank()) +
                                                           ggplot2::labs(x = "X",
                                                                         y = "Y")
                                           
                                           cluster_plot_no_text <- cluster_plot +
                                                                   journal_theme_no_text() +
                                                                   ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL)
                                           
                                           # Export plots
                                           if (isTRUE(export_plots)) {output_paths <- list(knn_plot = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_knn_distance_plot.tiff")),
                                                                                                                   plot = knn_plot,
                                                                                                                   width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                   height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                   dpi = figure_dpi),
                                                                                           knn_plot_no_text = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_knn_distance_plot_no_text.tiff")),
                                                                                                                           plot = knn_plot_no_text,
                                                                                                                           width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                           height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                           dpi = figure_dpi),
                                                                                           cluster_plot = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_Cluster_plot.tiff")),
                                                                                                                       plot = cluster_plot,
                                                                                                                       width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                       height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                       dpi = figure_dpi),
                                                                                           cluster_plot_no_text = journal_save(filename = file.path(output_dir, paste0(df_name, "_Cluster_plot_no_text.tiff")),
                                                                                                                               plot = cluster_plot_no_text,
                                                                                                                               width_mm = figure_width_mm,
                                                                                                                               height_mm = figure_height_mm,
                                                                                                                               dpi = figure_dpi))}
                                           
                                           return(df_dbscan_valid)}
```

# Function for ADM0 and ADM1 disaggregation
```{r disaggregation}
disaggregate <- function(df,
                         Population,
                         gpkg_dir,
                         adm0_batch_size = 10,
                         adm1_batch_size = 10,
                         adm1_max_sample = 10000,
                         adm1_cluster_divisor = 3000,
                         adm1_sample_fraction = 0.8,
                         verbose = TRUE) {msg <- function(...) {if (isTRUE(verbose)) {message(...) 
                                                                flush.console()}}
                         
                                          required_columns <- c("max", "geo0", "geo1", "longitude", "latitude")
                                          missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(df))
                                          
                                          if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {stop("Input dataset is missing required column(s): ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)}
                                          
                                          # 1. Prepare target ADM1 and ADM2 geometries for utilization
                                          Population_crs <- raster::crs(Population)
                                          
                                          ADM1_sf <- sf::st_read(file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM1.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
                                                     dplyr::select(geo_admin1, geoboundary_key, name, geom) %>%
                                                     dplyr::rename(ADM1 = name, geo1 = geom) %>%
                                                     sf::st_as_sf() %>%
                                                     sf::st_transform(crs = Population_crs)

                                          ADM2_sf <- sf::st_read(file.path(gpkg_dir, "ADM2.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) %>%
                                                     dplyr::select(geo_admin2, geoboundary_key, name, geom) %>%
                                                     dplyr::rename(ADM2 = name, geo2 = geom) %>%
                                                     sf::st_as_sf() %>%
                                                     sf::st_transform(crs = Population_crs)

                                          ADM1_geom <- ADM1_sf %>%
                                                       tibble::as_tibble() %>%
                                                       dplyr::select(geo_admin1, geo1)

                                          ADM2_geom <- ADM2_sf %>%
                                                      tibble::as_tibble() %>%
                                                      dplyr::select(geo_admin2, geo2)

                                          ADM1_attr <- ADM1_sf %>%
                                                       sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                       dplyr::select(geo_admin1, geoboundary_key, ADM1)

                                          ADM2_attr <- ADM2_sf %>%
                                                       sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                       dplyr::select(geo_admin2, geoboundary_key, ADM2)

                                          ADM1_centroids <- ADM1_sf %>%
                                                            dplyr::mutate(centroid_geom = sf::st_point_on_surface(geo1),
                                                                          ADM1_centroid_LON = sf::st_coordinates(centroid_geom)[, 1],
                                                                          ADM1_centroid_LAT = sf::st_coordinates(centroid_geom)[, 2]) %>%
                                                            sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                            dplyr::select(geo_admin1, ADM1_centroid_LON, ADM1_centroid_LAT) %>%
                                                            dplyr::distinct()

                                          ADM2_centroids <- ADM2_sf %>%
                                                            dplyr::mutate(centroid_geom = sf::st_point_on_surface(geo2),
                                                                          ADM2_centroid_LON = sf::st_coordinates(centroid_geom)[, 1],
                                                                          ADM2_centroid_LAT = sf::st_coordinates(centroid_geom)[, 2]) %>%
                                                            sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                            dplyr::select(geo_admin2, ADM2_centroid_LON, ADM2_centroid_LAT) %>%
                                                            dplyr::distinct()
                                          
                                          # 2. ADM0 to ADM1 disaggregation
                                          disaggregate_adm0_to_adm1 <- function(df) {ADM0_PrevalenceData <- df %>%
                                                                                                            dplyr::filter(max == "ADM0")
                                          
                                                                                     if (nrow(ADM0_PrevalenceData) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                          
                                                                                     DF <- data.frame()
                                                                                     
                                                                                     # Process in batches
                                                                                     for (start_row in seq(1, nrow(ADM0_PrevalenceData), by = adm0_batch_size)) {end_row <- min(start_row + adm0_batch_size - 1, nrow(ADM0_PrevalenceData))
                                                                                     for (i in start_row:end_row) {tryCatch({# Crop & mask population to ADM0 polygon & extract pop values
                                                                                                                             Polygon <- ADM0_PrevalenceData[i, ]
                                                                                     
                                                                                                                             Polygon_sf <- Polygon %>%
                                                                                                                                           sf::st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geo0")
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             PolygonPop <- raster::raster(terra::crop(x = terra::rast(Population),
                                                                                                                                                                      y = terra::vect(Polygon_sf),
                                                                                                                                                                      mask = TRUE))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             raster::extent(PolygonPop) <- raster::extent(Polygon_sf)
                                                                                                                             vals <- raster::getValues(PolygonPop)
                                                                                                                             keep <- which(!is.na(vals) & vals > 0)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (length(keep) == 0) {next}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             Coordinates <- raster::coordinates(PolygonPop)[keep, , drop = FALSE]
                                                                                                                             PolygonPopValues <- vals[keep]
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             # Identify the highest-population cluster out of max 3.
                                                                                                                             if (nrow(Coordinates) > 1) {k <- min(3, nrow(Coordinates))
                                                                                                                                                         Cluster <- stats::kmeans(Coordinates, centers = k)
                                                                                                                                                         ClusterPop <- sapply(seq_len(max(Cluster$cluster)),
                                                                                                                                                                              function(z) {sum(PolygonPopValues[Cluster$cluster == z], na.rm = TRUE)})
                                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                                         Max <- which.max(ClusterPop)
                                                                                                                                                         Centroid <- colMeans(Coordinates[Cluster$cluster == Max, , drop = FALSE])} 
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             else {Centroid <- Coordinates[1, ]}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             df_centroid <- data.frame(original_row_id = i,
                                                                                                                                                       disaggregation_source = "ADM0",
                                                                                                                                                       disaggregation_target = "ADM1",
                                                                                                                                                       disaggregation_clusters = 1,
                                                                                                                                                       disaggregation_weight = 1,
                                                                                                                                                       LON = Centroid[1],
                                                                                                                                                       LAT = Centroid[2])
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             DF <- rbind(DF,
                                                                                                                                         cbind(df_centroid, Polygon[rep(1, nrow(df_centroid)), ])) %>%
                                                                                                                                   dplyr::distinct()
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             msg("ADM0 -> ADM1 | row ", i)}, error = function(e) {msg("Error ADM0 -> ADM1 in row ", i, ": ", e$message)})}}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     if (nrow(DF) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     DF <- DF %>%
                                                                                           dplyr::filter(!is.na(LON) & !is.na(LAT))
                                                                                     
                                                                                     if (nrow(DF) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     ADM0_points <- sf::st_as_sf(DF, coords = c("LON", "LAT"), crs = Population_crs, remove = FALSE)
                                                                                     
                                                                                     ADM0_points <- ADM0_points %>%
                                                                                                    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("geo0", "geo_admin1", "geo1", "ADM1", "geoboundary_key")))
                                                                                     
                                                                                     sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
                                                                                     ADM0_joined <- sf::st_join(ADM0_points,
                                                                                                                ADM1_sf %>% dplyr::select(geo_admin1),
                                                                                                                join = sf::st_intersects,
                                                                                                                left = FALSE)
                                                                                     sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)
                                                                                     
                                                                                     if (nrow(ADM0_joined) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     # Update record with selected ADM1
                                                                                     ADM0_joined %>%
                                                                                     sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::rename(disaggregation_LON = LON,
                                                                                                   disaggregation_LAT = LAT) %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::left_join(ADM1_geom, by = "geo_admin1") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::left_join(ADM1_attr, by = "geo_admin1") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::left_join(ADM1_centroids, by = "geo_admin1") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::mutate(longitude = ADM1_centroid_LON,
                                                                                                   latitude = ADM1_centroid_LAT,
                                                                                                   max = "ADM1",
                                                                                                   origin_disaggregation = "ADM0_to_ADM1") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::distinct()}
                                          
                                          # 3. ADM1 to ADM2 disaggregation
                                          disaggregate_adm1_to_adm2 <- function(df) {ADM1_PrevalenceData <- df %>%
                                                                                                            dplyr::filter(max == "ADM1")
                                          
                                                                                     if (nrow(ADM1_PrevalenceData) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                          
                                                                                     DF <- data.frame()
                                                                                     
                                                                                     # Process in batches
                                                                                     for (start_row in seq(1, nrow(ADM1_PrevalenceData), by = adm1_batch_size)) {end_row <- min(start_row + adm1_batch_size - 1, nrow(ADM1_PrevalenceData))
                                                                                     for (i in start_row:end_row) {tryCatch({# Crop & mask population to ADM1 polygon & extract pop values
                                                                                                                             Polygon <- ADM1_PrevalenceData[i, ]
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             Polygon_sf <- Polygon %>%
                                                                                                                                           sf::st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "geo1")
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             PolygonPop <- raster::raster(terra::crop(x = terra::rast(Population),
                                                                                                                                                                      y = terra::vect(Polygon_sf),
                                                                                                                                                                      mask = TRUE))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             raster::extent(PolygonPop) <- raster::extent(Polygon_sf)
                                                                                                                             vals <- raster::getValues(PolygonPop)
                                                                                                                             keep <- which(!is.na(vals) & vals > 0)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (length(keep) == 0) {next}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             Coordinates <- raster::coordinates(PolygonPop)[keep, , drop = FALSE]
                                                                                                                             PolygonPopValues <- vals[keep]
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (nrow(Coordinates) == 0 ||
                                                                                                                                 sum(PolygonPopValues, na.rm = TRUE) == 0) {next}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             # Cap population-positive raster cells to 10000
                                                                                                                             PointCount <- min(adm1_max_sample,
                                                                                                                                               floor(adm1_sample_fraction * length(PolygonPopValues)))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (PointCount < 1) {next}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             # Scale down how many k-means centroids to generate by dviding population-positive raster cells by 3000
                                                                                                                             PointCountResult <- floor(PointCount / min(adm1_cluster_divisor, PointCount))
```
