```{r disaggregation}
                                                                                                                             PointCountResult <- max(1, PointCountResult)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             # Draw a population-weighted sample from the raster cells
                                                                                                                             InitialSample <- sort(sample(seq_along(PolygonPopValues),
                                                                                                                                                          size = PointCount,
                                                                                                                                                          replace = FALSE,
                                                                                                                                                          prob = PolygonPopValues / sum(PolygonPopValues, na.rm = TRUE)))
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             CoordinateSample <- Coordinates[InitialSample, , drop = FALSE]
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             # Cluster the samples
                                                                                                                             CoordinateClusters <- stats::kmeans(CoordinateSample,
                                                                                                                                                                 centers = PointCountResult, nstart = 30)
                                                                                                                             ClusterCentroid <- CoordinateClusters$centers
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             if (is.null(dim(ClusterCentroid))) {ClusterCentroid <- matrix(ClusterCentroid, nrow = 1)}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             # Define to how many ADM2 each ADM1 value will be assigned to
                                                                                                                             CentroidCount <- nrow(ClusterCentroid)
                                                                                                                             Weight <- CoordinateClusters$size / sum(CoordinateClusters$size)
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             df_centroid <- data.frame()
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             for (y in seq_len(CentroidCount)) {df_centroid <- rbind(df_centroid,
                                                                                                                                                                                     data.frame(original_row_id = i,
                                                                                                                                                                                                disaggregation_source = "ADM1",
                                                                                                                                                                                                disaggregation_target = "ADM2",
                                                                                                                                                                                                disaggregation_clusters = CentroidCount,
                                                                                                                                                                                                LON = ClusterCentroid[y, 1],
                                                                                                                                                                                                LAT = ClusterCentroid[y, 2],
                                                                                                                                                                                                disaggregation_weight = Weight[y]))}
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             DF <- rbind(DF,
                                                                                                                                         cbind(df_centroid, Polygon[rep(1, nrow(df_centroid)), ])) %>%
                                                                                                                                   dplyr::distinct()
                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                             msg("ADM1 -> ADM2 | row ", i)}, error = function(e) {msg("Error ADM1 -> ADM2 in row ", i, ": ", e$message)})}}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     if (nrow(DF) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     DF <- DF %>%
                                                                                           dplyr::filter(!is.na(LON) & !is.na(LAT))
                                                                                     
                                                                                     if (nrow(DF) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     ADM1_points <- sf::st_as_sf(DF,
                                                                                                                 coords = c("LON", "LAT"),
                                                                                                                 crs = Population_crs,
                                                                                                                 remove = FALSE)
                                                                                     
                                                                                     ADM1_points <- ADM1_points %>%
                                                                                                    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("geo1", "geo_admin2", "geo2", "ADM2", "geoboundary_key")))
                                                                                     
                                                                                     sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
                                                                                     ADM1_joined <- sf::st_join(ADM1_points,
                                                                                                                ADM2_sf %>% dplyr::select(geo_admin2),
                                                                                                                join = sf::st_intersects,
                                                                                                                left = FALSE)
                                                                                     sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)
                                                                                     
                                                                                     if (nrow(ADM1_joined) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                                     
                                                                                     # Update record with selected ADM2
                                                                                     ADM1_joined %>%
                                                                                     sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::rename(disaggregation_LON = LON,
                                                                                                   disaggregation_LAT = LAT) %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::left_join(ADM2_geom, by = "geo_admin2") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::left_join(ADM2_attr, by = "geo_admin2") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::left_join(ADM2_centroids, by = "geo_admin2") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::mutate(longitude = ADM2_centroid_LON,
                                                                                                   latitude = ADM2_centroid_LAT,
                                                                                                   max = "ADM2",
                                                                                                   origin_disaggregation = "ADM1_to_ADM2") %>%
                                                                                     dplyr::distinct()}
                                          
                                          # 4. Apply disaggregation and retain original non-ADM0/non-ADM1 rows
                                          kept_rows <- df %>%
                                                       dplyr::filter(!max %in% c("ADM0", "ADM1")) %>%
                                                       dplyr::mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original",
                                                                     disaggregation_source = NA_character_,
                                                                     disaggregation_target = NA_character_,
                                                                     disaggregation_clusters = NA_real_,
                                                                     disaggregation_weight = 1,
                                                                     original_row_id = NA_integer_,
                                                                     disaggregation_LON = NA_real_,
                                                                     disaggregation_LAT = NA_real_,
                                                                     ADM1_centroid_LON = NA_real_,
                                                                     ADM1_centroid_LAT = NA_real_,
                                                                     ADM2_centroid_LON = NA_real_,
                                                                     ADM2_centroid_LAT = NA_real_)
                                          
                                          adm0_disaggregated <- disaggregate_adm0_to_adm1(df)
                                          adm1_disaggregated <- disaggregate_adm1_to_adm2(df)
                                          
                                          df_disaggregated <- dplyr::bind_rows(kept_rows, adm0_disaggregated, adm1_disaggregated) %>%
                                                              dplyr::distinct()
                                          
                                          # 5. Finalize structure
                                          df_clean <- df_disaggregated %>%
                                                      sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                      dplyr::mutate(longitude = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(ADM2_centroid_LON) ~ ADM2_centroid_LON,
                                                                                                 !is.na(ADM1_centroid_LON) ~ ADM1_centroid_LON,
                                                                                                 TRUE ~ longitude),
                                                                    latitude = dplyr::case_when(!is.na(ADM2_centroid_LAT) ~ ADM2_centroid_LAT,
                                                                                                !is.na(ADM1_centroid_LAT) ~ ADM1_centroid_LAT,
                                                                                                TRUE ~ latitude)) %>%
                                                      dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("disaggregation_source", "disaggregation_target", "disaggregation_clusters",
                                                                                     "disaggregation_weight", "original_row_id", "disaggregation_LON", 
                                                                                     "disaggregation_LAT", "ADM1_centroid_LON", "ADM1_centroid_LAT", 
                                                                                     "ADM2_centroid_LON", "ADM2_centroid_LAT", "geo0", "geo1", "geo2", "geometry")))
                                          
                                          point_geometry <- sf::st_as_sf(df_clean,
                                                                         coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                                                                         crs = sf::st_crs(df$geo0),
                                                                         remove = FALSE)
                                          
                                          return(point_geometry)}
```

# Dataset versions
```{r versioning}
# 1. Raw - select 1 per dup coordinate & spatial noise removed
Data1 <- Data %>% 
         prioritize(prefer_original = FALSE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
         dplyr::select(-geo0, -geo1, -geo2, -geometry) %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area)

# 2. Multi-location data removed - select 1 per dup coordinate & spatial noise removed
Data2 <- Data %>% 
         filter(multi != "Yes") %>% 
         prioritize(prefer_original = FALSE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
         dplyr::select(-geo0, -geo1, -geo2, -geometry) %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area)

# 3. Hardy-Weinberg computed data removed - select 1 per dup coordinate & spatial noise removed
Data3 <- Data %>% 
         filter(recalculate != "C") %>%
         prioritize(prefer_original = FALSE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
         dplyr::select(-geo0, -geo1, -geo2, -geometry) %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area)

# 4. Non-quality appraised & mid/high bias data removed - select 1 per dup coordinate & spatial noise removed
Data4 <- Data %>% 
         filter(bias_flag == "Low" & Qualified == "Yes" & sample_size_comment == "NULL") %>% 
         prioritize(prefer_original = FALSE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
         dplyr::select(-geo0, -geo1, -geo2, -geometry) %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area)

# 5. Non-quality appraised & mid/high bias data removed [excluding non-quality appraised trusted sources] - select 1 per dup coordinate & spatial noise removed
Data5 <- Data %>% 
         filter((bias_flag == "Low" & Qualified == "Yes" & sample_size_comment == "NULL") | (pmid == 18568278 | coalesce(str_detect(report, fixed("Kingdom of Bahrain Ministry of Health")), FALSE))) %>% # Must include any trusted sources such as 
         prioritize(prefer_original = FALSE) %>%                                                                                                                                                          # Ministry data or Modell Almanac
         isolate() %>%
         mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
         dplyr::select(-geo0, -geo1, -geo2, -geometry) %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area)

# 6. Non-quality appraised & mid/high bias data removed - select 1 per dup coordinate post dissagregation & spatial noise removed
Data6 <- Data %>% 
         filter(bias_flag == "Low" & Qualified == "Yes" & sample_size_comment == "NULL") %>% 
         filter(!(max == "ADM0" & Area >= 20000)) %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area) %>%
         disaggregate(Population = Population,
                      gpkg_dir = gpkg_dir) %>%
         mutate(latitude = round(latitude, 4),
                longitude = round(longitude, 4)) %>%     
         prioritize(prefer_original = TRUE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>%
         dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(colnames(Data1)))

# 7. Non-quality appraised & mid/high bias data removed - select 1 per dup coordinate & spatial noise retained
Data7 <- Data %>% 
         filter(bias_flag == "Low" & Qualified == "Yes" & sample_size_comment == "NULL") %>%  
         prioritize(prefer_original = FALSE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
         dplyr::select(-geo0, -geo1, -geo2, -geometry) %>%
         st_drop_geometry() %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area)

# 8. Non-quality appraised & mid/high bias data removed - select 1 per dup coordinate post dissagregation & spatial noise retained
Data8 <- Data %>% 
         filter(bias_flag == "Low" & Qualified == "Yes" & sample_size_comment == "NULL") %>%  
         filter(!(max == "ADM0" & Area >= 20000)) %>% 
         dplyr::select(-Area) %>%
         disaggregate(Population = Population,
                      gpkg_dir = gpkg_dir) %>%
         mutate(latitude = round(latitude, 4),
                longitude = round(longitude, 4)) %>%    
         prioritize(prefer_original = TRUE) %>%
         isolate() %>%
         dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(colnames(Data1))) %>%
         st_drop_geometry()

# Exclude geographically isolated countries
Data9 <- Data8 %>%
         filter(!(ADM0 %in% c("Liberia", "Vanuatu")))

rm(disaggregate, isolate, prioritize)
```

# Metrics
```{r metrics pre covariate selection, warning = FALSE}
Data <- Data %>% 
        mutate(origin_disaggregation = "Original") %>%
        dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(colnames(Data1))) 

summaryM <- function(...,
                     include_cluster_diagnostics = FALSE,
                     output_dir = NULL,
                     output_filename = "Dataset_diagnostics.csv",
                     export = FALSE) {Datasets <- list(...)
                     
                                      percent_true <- function(x) {round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2)}
                                      n_percent <- function(n, percent) {if (is.na(n) || is.na(percent)) {return(NA_character_)} 
                                                                         paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")}
                                      safe_min <- function(x) {if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else min(x, na.rm = TRUE)}
                                      safe_max <- function(x) {if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) NA_real_ else max(x, na.rm = TRUE)}
                                      get_col <- function(df, col) {if (col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))}
                                      
                                      count_by_values <- function(x, levels = NULL) {if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) return(NA_character_)
                                                                                     if (!is.null(levels)) {counts <- table(factor(x, levels = levels), useNA = "no")} 
                                                                                     else {counts <- sort(table(x, useNA = "no"), decreasing = TRUE)}
                                        
                                                                                     paste0(names(counts), ": ", as.integer(counts), collapse = "; ")}
                                      
                                      count_numeric_bins <- function(x, breaks, labels) {x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
                                                                                         if (length(x) == 0 || all(is.na(x))) return(NA_character_)
                                      
                                                                                         binned <- cut(x,
                                                                                                       breaks = breaks,
                                                                                                       labels = labels,
                                                                                                       include.lowest = TRUE,
                                                                                                       right = TRUE)
                                                                                         
                                                                                         counts <- table(factor(binned, levels = labels), useNA = "no")
                                                                                         paste0(labels, ": ", as.integer(counts), collapse = "; ")}
                                      
                                      total_bin_breaks <- c(0,
                                                            100,
                                                            1000,
                                                            10000,
                                                            100000,
                                                            1000000,
                                                            10000000,
                                                            100000000,
                                                            1288400000)
                                      
                                      total_bin_labels <- c("1-100",
                                                            "101-1,000",
                                                            "1,001-10,000",
                                                            "10,001-100,000",
                                                            "100,001-1,000,000",
                                                            "1,000,001-10,000,000",
                                                            "10,000,001-100,000,000",
                                                            "100,000,001-1,288,400,000")
                                      
                                      year_bin_breaks <- c(1964,
                                                           1970,
                                                           1980,
                                                           1990,
                                                           2000,
                                                           2010,
                                                           2020,
                                                           2023)
                                      
                                      year_bin_labels <- c("1964-1970",
                                                           "1971-1980",
                                                           "1981-1990",
                                                           "1991-2000",
                                                           "2001-2010",
                                                           "2011-2020",
                                                           "2021-2023")
                                      
                                      compute_one_dataset <- function(df, dataset_name) {multi <- get_col(df, "multi")
                                                                                         recalculate <- get_col(df, "recalculate")
                                                                                         bias_flag <- get_col(df, "bias_flag")
                                                                                         Qualified <- get_col(df, "Qualified")
                                                                                         sample_size_comment <- get_col(df, "sample_size_comment")
                                                                                         longitude <- get_col(df, "longitude")
                                                                                         latitude <- get_col(df, "latitude")
                                                                                         max_adm <- get_col(df, "max")
                                                                                         total <- get_col(df, "total")
                                                                                         geo_admin0 <- get_col(df, "ADM0")
                                                                                         year <- get_col(df, "year")
                                                                                         
                                                                                         pmid <- get_col(df, "pmid")
                                                                                         report <- get_col(df, "report")
                                                                                         trusted_NoQC <- (suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pmid)) == 18568278 | dplyr::coalesce(stringr::str_detect(report, 
                                                                                                                                                                                               stringr::fixed("Kingdom of Bahrain Ministry of Health")),
                                                                                                                                                                           FALSE))
    
                                                                                         coord_id <- paste(round(longitude, 4), round(latitude, 4), sep = "_")
                                                                                         target_rows <- recalculate != "C" & multi != "Yes" & max_adm %in% c("ADM2", "Site")
                                                                                         target_coord_id <- coord_id[target_rows]
                                                                                         duplicate_target_coords <- names(table(target_coord_id))[table(target_coord_id) > 1]
                                                                                         
                                                                                         disaggregated_n <- if ("origin_disaggregation" %in% names(df)) {sum(df$origin_disaggregation != "Original", na.rm = TRUE)} else {NA_integer_}
                                                                                         disaggregated_percent <- if ("origin_disaggregation" %in% names(df)) {percent_true(df$origin_disaggregation != "Original")} else {NA_real_}
                                                                                         
                                                                                         output <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                  Sources = length(df$source_id %>% unique()),
                                                                                                                  Timeframe = paste0(min(df$year)," - ", max(df$year)),
                                                                                                                  Entries = nrow(df),
                                                                                                                  Countries = if ("geo_admin0" %in% names(df)) {dplyr::n_distinct(df$geo_admin0, na.rm = TRUE)} else {NA_integer_},
                                                                                                                  'Carrier prevalence range' = paste0(if ("value" %in% names(df)) round(safe_min(df$value), 1) else NA_real_, " - ", 
                                                                                                                                                      if ("value" %in% names(df)) round(safe_max(df$value), 1) else NA_real_),
                                                                                                                  'Sample size range' = paste0(if ("total" %in% names(df)) round(safe_min(df$total), 1) else NA_real_, " - ", 
                                                                                                                                               if ("total" %in% names(df)) round(safe_max(df$total), 1) else NA_real_),
                                                                                                                  'Entries from specific ethnic groups' = paste0(df %>% filter(!(ethnicity_name %in% c("NULL", "Mixed/Multiple"))) %>% nrow(), 
                                                                                                                                                          " (", round((df %>% filter(!(ethnicity_name %in% c("NULL", "Mixed/Multiple"))) %>% nrow()) / Entries *100, 2), "%)"),
                                                                                                                  Disaggregated = n_percent(disaggregated_n, disaggregated_percent),
                                                                                                                  'Multi-location' = n_percent(sum(multi == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), percent_true(multi == "Yes")),
                                                                                                                  'Hardy-Weinberg' = n_percent(sum(recalculate == "C", na.rm = TRUE), percent_true(recalculate == "C")),
                                                                                                                  Biased = n_percent(sum(!(bias_flag %in% c("Low", "Quality not appraised")) & Qualified != "Yes" & sample_size_comment != "NULL", na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                           percent_true(!(bias_flag %in% c("Low", "Quality not appraised")) & Qualified != "Yes" & sample_size_comment != "NULL")),
                                                                                                                  NoQC = n_percent(sum(bias_flag == "Quality not appraised", na.rm = TRUE), percent_true(bias_flag == "Quality not appraised")),
                                                                                                                  'NoQC without Trusted' = n_percent(sum(bias_flag == "Quality not appraised" & !trusted_NoQC, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                                     percent_true(bias_flag == "Quality not appraised" & !trusted_NoQC)),
                                                                                                                  'NoQC or Biased' = n_percent(sum(bias_flag == "Quality not appraised" | 
                                                                                                                                              (!(bias_flag %in% c("Low", "Quality not appraised")) & Qualified != "Yes" & sample_size_comment != "NULL"), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                     percent_true(bias_flag == "Quality not appraised" | 
                                                                                                                                                 (!(bias_flag %in% c("Low", "Quality not appraised")) & Qualified != "Yes" & sample_size_comment != "NULL"))),
                                                                                                                  'NoQC without Trusted or Biased' = n_percent(sum((bias_flag == "Quality not appraised" & !trusted_NoQC) | (!(bias_flag %in% c("Low", "Quality not appraised")) & Qualified != "Yes" & sample_size_comment != "NULL"), na.rm = TRUE), percent_true((bias_flag == "Quality not appraised" & !trusted_NoQC) | (!(bias_flag %in% c("Low", "Quality not appraised")) & Qualified != "Yes" & sample_size_comment != "NULL"))),
                                                                                                                  'Non-distinct ADM2/Site entries' = n_percent(sum(target_rows & coord_id %in% duplicate_target_coords, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                                     percent_true(target_rows & coord_id %in% duplicate_target_coords)),
                                                                                                                  'ADM0 entries left' = n_percent(sum(max_adm %in% c("ADM0"), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                             percent_true(max_adm %in% c("ADM0"))),
                                                                                                                  'ADM1 entries left' = n_percent(sum(max_adm %in% c("ADM1"), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                             percent_true(max_adm %in% c("ADM1"))),
                                                                                                                  'ADM2 entries left' = n_percent(sum(max_adm %in% c("ADM2"), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                             percent_true(max_adm %in% c("ADM2"))),
                                                                                                                  'Site-specified entries left' = n_percent(sum(max_adm %in% c("Site"), na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                                                                                             percent_true(max_adm %in% c("Site"))),
                                                                                                                  'Entries per max value' = count_by_values(max_adm, levels = c("ADM0", "ADM1", "ADM2", "Site")),
                                                                                                                  'Entries per sample size bin' = count_numeric_bins(total, breaks = total_bin_breaks, labels = total_bin_labels),
                                                                                                                  'Entries per timeframe bin' = count_numeric_bins(year, breaks = year_bin_breaks, labels = year_bin_labels),
                                                                                                                  'Entries per ADM0 country' = if ("geo_admin0" %in% names(df)) {count_by_values(geo_admin0)} else {NA_character_})
                                                                                         
                                                                                         if (isTRUE(include_cluster_diagnostics)) {cluster_0_n <- if ("Cluster" %in% names(df)) {sum(df$Cluster == 0, na.rm = TRUE)} else {NA_integer_}
                                                                                                                                   cluster_0_percent <- if ("Cluster" %in% names(df)) {percent_true(df$Cluster == 0)} else {NA_real_}
                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                   output <- output %>%
                                                                                                                                             dplyr::mutate('Spatial noise' = n_percent(cluster_0_n, cluster_0_percent))}
                                                                                         output}
                                      output_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(Datasets,
                                                                      compute_one_dataset)
                                      
                                      if (isTRUE(export)) {if (is.null(output_dir)) {stop("Please provide `output_dir` when `export = TRUE`.")}
                                        
                                      readr::write_csv(output_table, file.path(output_dir, output_filename))}
                                      
                                      return(output_table)}

Metric_summary_preC <- summaryM(Data = Data,
                                Data1 = Data1,
                                Data2 = Data2,
                                Data3 = Data3,
                                Data4 = Data4,
                                Data5 = Data5,
                                Data6 = Data6,
                                Data7 = Data7,
                                Data8 = Data8,
                                Data9 = Data9,
                                include_cluster_diagnostics = FALSE,
                                output_dir = "Output/",
                                output_filename = "Summary-metrics-pre-covariate-selection.csv",
                                export = TRUE)

rm(Data, Metric_summary_preC)
```

# Covariate addition
```{r covariate addition}
Datasets <- list('Dataset 1'  = Data1,
                 'Dataset 2'  = Data2,
                 'Dataset 3'  = Data3,
                 'Dataset 4'  = Data4,
                 'Dataset 5'  = Data5,
                 'Dataset 6'  = Data6,
                 'Dataset 7'  = Data7,
                 'Dataset 8'  = Data8)

ADM0_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM0_shapes, sf::st_crs(Covariates))
ADM1_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM1_shapes, sf::st_crs(Covariates))
ADM2_shapes <- sf::st_transform(ADM2_shapes, sf::st_crs(Covariates))

Variables <- c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization", "Consanguinity", "EFI", "RDI", "Counselling", "Prevention")

Extract <- function(Data,
                    lon_col = "longitude",
                    lat_col = "latitude",
                    max_col = "max") {Data <- Data %>%
                                              dplyr::mutate(.row_id = dplyr::row_number())
                    
                                      Data_sf <- Data %>%
                                                 sf::st_as_sf(coords = c(lon_col, lat_col),
                                                              crs = sf::st_crs(Covariates),
                                                              remove = FALSE)
                                      empty_values <- tibble::tibble(.row_id = Data$.row_id)
                                      
                                      for (v in Variables) {empty_values[[v]] <- NA_real_}
                                      
                                      # For site-specific records obtain covariate values at precise coordinates
                                      extract_site_values <- function(df_site) {if (nrow(df_site) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                        
                                      vals <- raster::extract(Covariates, sf::st_coordinates(df_site))
                                      vals <- as.data.frame(vals)
                                      names(vals) <- Variables
                                      
                                      dplyr::bind_cols(tibble::tibble(.row_id = df_site$.row_id), vals)}
                                      
                                      # For ADM0/ADM1/ADM2 centroid records obtain mean covariate value across corresponding polygon
                                      extract_polygon_means <- function(df_points, shapes_sf) {if (nrow(df_points) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                        
                                      sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)
                                      joined <- sf::st_join(df_points, shapes_sf, join = sf::st_within, left = TRUE) %>%
                                                dplyr::group_by(.row_id) %>%
                                                dplyr::slice(1) %>%
                                                dplyr::ungroup()
                                      sf::sf_use_s2(TRUE)
                                      
                                      vals_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(joined)), function(i) {this_polygon <- joined[i, ]
                                                                                              if (sf::st_is_empty(sf::st_geometry(this_polygon))) {return(rep(NA_real_, length(Variables)))}
                                      
                                      vals <- raster::extract(Covariates, this_polygon, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
                                      as.numeric(vals[1, ])})
                                      
                                      vals <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, vals_list))
                                      names(vals) <- Variables
                                      
                                      dplyr::bind_cols( tibble::tibble(.row_id = joined$.row_id), vals)}
                                      
                                      site_values <- Data_sf %>%
                                                     dplyr::filter(.data[[max_col]] == "Site") %>%
                                                     extract_site_values()
                                      
                                      adm0_values <- Data_sf %>%
                                                     dplyr::filter(.data[[max_col]] == "ADM0") %>%
                                                     extract_polygon_means(ADM0_shapes)
                                      
                                      adm1_values <- Data_sf %>%
                                                     dplyr::filter(.data[[max_col]] == "ADM1") %>%
                                                     extract_polygon_means(ADM1_shapes)
                                      
                                      adm2_values <- Data_sf %>% 
                                                     dplyr::filter(.data[[max_col]] == "ADM2") %>%
                                                     extract_polygon_means(ADM2_shapes)
                                      
                                      extracted_values <- dplyr::bind_rows(site_values, adm0_values, adm1_values, adm2_values)
                                      
                                      Result <- Data %>%
                                                dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(Variables)) %>%
                                                dplyr::left_join(extracted_values, by = ".row_id") %>%
                                                dplyr::arrange(.row_id) %>%
                                                dplyr::select(-.row_id)
                                      
                                      return(Result)}

Datasets <- lapply(Datasets, Extract)

rm(Extract, Data1, Data2, Data3, Data4, Data5, Data6, Data7, Data8)
```

# Covariate inspection & log transformation when skewed
```{r}
names(Covariates) <- c("Population count",
                       "Plasmodium falciparum incidence (per 1,000 population)",
                       "Degree of urbanization",
                       "Consanguinity (%)", 
                       "Ethnic Fractionalization Index",
                       "Religious Diversity Index",
                       "Counselling availability",
                       "Prevention program availability")

Variables <- c("Population count",
               "Plasmodium falciparum incidence (per 1,000 population)",
               "Degree of urbanization",
               "Consanguinity (%)", 
               "Ethnic Fractionalization Index",
               "Religious Diversity Index",
               "Counselling availability",
               "Prevention program availability")

Datasets <- lapply(Datasets,
                   function(df) {idx <- match(c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization", "Consanguinity", "EFI", "RDI", "Counselling", "Prevention"), names(df))
                                 keep <- !is.na(idx)
                                 names(df)[idx[keep]] <- Variables[keep]
                                 df})

empLogit <- function(p, eps = 1e-3) {p_adj <- pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps)
                                     log(p_adj / (1 - p_adj))}

covariateM <- function(Datasets,
                       Variables,
                       value_col = "value",
                       output_dir = "Output/Covariate_diagnostics/",
                       skew_threshold = 1,
                       panel_datasets = paste0("Data", 1:8),
                       log_base = exp(1),
                       export = TRUE) {if (is.null(names(Datasets)) || any(names(Datasets) == "")) {stop("Datasets must be a named list, e.g. list(Data1 = Data1, Data2 = Data2).")}
                                       if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
  
                                       histogram_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Histograms")
                                       relationship_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Linear_relationships")
                                       panel_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "Panel_plots")
                                       
                                       if (!dir.exists(histogram_dir)) {dir.create(histogram_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
                                       if (!dir.exists(relationship_dir)) {dir.create(relationship_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
                                       if (!dir.exists(panel_dir)) {dir.create(panel_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
                                       
                                       html_label <- function(x) {stringr::str_replace(x, "Plasmodium falciparum", "<i>Plasmodium falciparum</i>")}
                                       
                                       theme <- ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
                                                ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                               plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                               axis.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, colour = "black"),
                                                               axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, colour = "black"),
                                                               axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
                                                               axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
                                                               strip.placement = "outside",
                                                               strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                               strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.9, margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 4)),
                                                               strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", lineheight = 0.9),
                                                               panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                               panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                               panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
                                                               legend.position = "bottom",
                                                               legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                               legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
                                                               plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
                                       
                                       theme_no_text <- ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "Times New Roman") +
                                                        ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       strip.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       strip.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       strip.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.25),
                                                                       legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       legend.text = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                                                                       legend.position = "none",
                                                                       plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(8, 8, 8, 8))
                                       
                                       save_versions <- function(filename_base,
                                                                        plot,
                                                                        width_mm,
                                                                        height_mm,
                                                                        dpi = 300){tryCatch({ggplot2::ggsave(filename = paste0(filename_base, "_with_text.tiff"),
                                                                                                    plot = plot + theme,
                                                                                                    width = width_mm,
                                                                                                    height = height_mm,
                                                                                                    units = "mm",
                                                                                                    dpi = dpi,
                                                                                                    bg = "white",
                                                                                                    limitsize = FALSE)
                                         
                                                                                    ggplot2::ggsave(filename = paste0(filename_base, "_no_text.tiff"),
                                                                                                    plot = plot + theme_no_text,
                                                                                                    width = width_mm,
                                                                                                    height = height_mm,
                                                                                                    units = "mm",
                                                                                                    dpi = dpi,
                                                                                                    bg = "white",
                                                                                                    limitsize = FALSE)},
                                                                                    finally = {grDevices::graphics.off()
                                                                                               gc()})}
                                       
                                       safe_filename <- function(x) {gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", x)}
                                       safe_skewness <- function(x) {x <- x[is.finite(x)]
                                       
                                                                     if (length(unique(x)) < 3) {return(NA_real_)}
                                       
                                                                     moments::skewness(x, na.rm = TRUE)}
                                       
                                       log_transform_safe <- function(x) {x <- as.numeric(x)
                                                                          min_x <- suppressWarnings(min(x, na.rm = TRUE))
                                                                          
                                                                          if (!is.finite(min_x)) {return(x)}
                                                                          if (min_x <= 0) {shift <- abs(min_x) + 1
                                                                                           return(log(x + shift, base = log_base))}
                                                                          
                                                                          log(x, base = log_base)}
                                       
                                       label_map <- c("Population count" =  "'Population count'",
                                                       "Plasmodium falciparum incidence (per 1,000 population)" = "atop(italic('Plasmodium falciparum')~incidence, '(per 1,000 population)')",
                                                      "Degree of urbanization" = "'Degree of urbanization'",
                                                      "Consanguinity (%)" = "'Consanguinity (%)'",
                                                      "Ethnic Fractionalization Index" = "'Ethnic Fractionalization Index'",
                                                      "Religious Diversity Index" = "'Religious Diversity Index'",
                                                      "Counselling availability" = "'Counselling availability'",
                                                      "Prevention program availability" = "'Prevention program availability'")
                                       
                                       make_panel_data <- function(df, 
                                                                   Variables,
                                                                   value_col,
                                                                   transformed_covariates = character(0)) {available_vars <- Variables[Variables %in% names(df)]
                                                                                                           if (length(available_vars) == 0 || !value_col %in% names(df)) {return(NULL)}
                                                                   
                                                                                                           df %>%
                                                                                                           dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c(value_col, available_vars))) %>%
                                                                                                           tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(available_vars),
                                                                                                                               names_to = "Covariate",
                                                                                                                               values_to = "Covariate_value") %>%
                                                                                                           dplyr::filter(!is.na(Covariate_value),
                                                                                                                         !is.na(.data[[value_col]]),
                                                                                                                         is.finite(Covariate_value),
                                                                                                                         is.finite(.data[[value_col]])) %>%
                                                                                                           dplyr::mutate(.emp_logit_value = empLogit(.data[[value_col]] / 100),
                                                                                                                         Covariate_label = dplyr::recode(Covariate, !!!label_map),
                                                                                                                         Covariate_label = factor(Covariate_label,
                                                                                                                                                  levels = dplyr::recode(Variables, !!!label_map)))}
                                       
                                       plot_histogram_panel <- function(df, 
                                                                        dataset_name, 
                                                                        stage, 
                                                                        transformed_covariates = character(0)) {panel_df <- make_panel_data(df = df,
                                                                                                                                            Variables = Variables,
                                                                                                                                            value_col = value_col,
                                                                                                                                            transformed_covariates = transformed_covariates)
                                                                        
                                                                        if (is.null(panel_df) || nrow(panel_df) == 0) {return(invisible(NULL))}

                                                                             ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Covariate_label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4, strip.position = "bottom", labeller = ggplot2::label_parsed)  +
                                                                             ggplot2::theme(panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")) +
                                                                             ggplot2::labs(x = NULL,
                                                                                           y = "Frequency")
                                                                        
                                                                        save_versions(filename_base = file.path(panel_dir,
                                                                                                                       paste0(safe_filename(dataset_name),
                                                                                                                              "_all_covariates_histograms_",
                                                                                                                              safe_filename(stage))),
                                                                                             plot = p,
                                                                                             width_mm = 250,
                                                                                             height_mm = 130,
                                                                                             dpi = 300)
                                                                        
                                                                        invisible(p)}
                                       
                                       plot_relationship_panel <- function(df, 
                                                                           dataset_name, 
                                                                           stage, 
                                                                           transformed_covariates = character(0)) {panel_df <- make_panel_data(df = df,
                                                                                                                                               Variables = Variables,

                                                                                                                                               transformed_covariates = transformed_covariates)

                                                                                ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.45, size = 0.7, colour = "black", na.rm = TRUE) +

                                                                                ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ Covariate_label, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4, strip.position = "bottom", labeller = ggplot2::label_parsed) +
                                                                                ggplot2::theme(panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")) +
                                                                                ggplot2::labs(x = NULL,
```
