```{r}
                                                                           save_versions(filename_base = file.path(panel_dir,
                                                                                                                          paste0(safe_filename(dataset_name),
                                                                                                                                 "_all_covariates_LR_",
                                                                                                                                 safe_filename(stage))),
                                                                                                plot = p,
                                                                                                width_mm = 250,
                                                                                                height_mm = 130,
                                                                                                dpi = 300)
                                                                           
                                                                           invisible(p)}
                                       
                                       plot_histogram <- function(plot_df, dataset_name, covariate, stage) {p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[covariate]])) +
                                                                                                                 ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30,
                                                                                                                                         colour = "black",
                                                                                                                                         fill = "grey70",
                                                                                                                                         linewidth = 0.2,
                                                                                                                                         na.rm = TRUE) +
                                                                                                                 ggplot2::labs(x = html_label(covariate),
                                                                                                                               y = "Frequency")
                                       
                                                                                                            save_versions(filename_base = file.path(histogram_dir,
                                                                                                                                                           paste0(safe_filename(dataset_name), "_",
                                                                                                                                                                  safe_filename(covariate),
                                                                                                                                                                  "_histogram_",
                                                                                                                                                                  safe_filename(stage))),
                                                                                                                                 plot = p,
                                                                                                                                 width_mm = 150,
                                                                                                                                 height_mm = 130,
                                                                                                                                 dpi = 300)
                                                                                                            
                                                                                                            invisible(p)}
                                       
                                       plot_relationship <- function(plot_df, dataset_name, covariate, stage) {plot_df <- plot_df %>%
                                                                                                                          dplyr::mutate(.emp_logit_value = empLogit(.data[[value_col]] / 100))
                                       
                                                                                                               p <- ggplot2::ggplot(plot_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .data[[covariate]], y = .emp_logit_value)) +
                                                                                                                    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.45,
                                                                                                                                        size = 0.7,
                                                                                                                                        colour = "black",
                                                                                                                                        na.rm = TRUE) +
                                                                                                                    ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm",
                                                                                                                                         se = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                         na.rm = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                         colour = "#BE1D54",
                                                                                                                                         linewidth = 0.45) +
                                                                                                                    ggplot2::labs(x = html_label(covariate),
                                                                                                                                  y = "Empirical logit(β-thalassaemia carrier prevalence (%))")
                                                                                                               
                                                                                                               save_versions(filename_base = file.path(relationship_dir,
                                                                                                                                                              paste0(safe_filename(dataset_name), "_",
                                                                                                                                                                     safe_filename(covariate),
                                                                                                                                                                     "_LR_",
                                                                                                                                                                     safe_filename(stage))),
                                                                                                                                    plot = p,
                                                                                                                                    width_mm = 150,
                                                                                                                                    height_mm = 130,
                                                                                                                                    dpi = 300)
                                                                                                               
                                                                                                               invisible(p)}
                                       
                                       transformation_log <- list()
                                       
                                       Datasets_out <- purrr::imap(Datasets,
                                                                   function(df, dataset_name) {if (dataset_name %in% panel_datasets) {plot_histogram_panel(df = df,
                                                                                                                                                           dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                           stage = "pre-log transformation",
                                                                                                                                                           transformed_covariates = character(0))
                                                                     
                                                                                                                                      plot_relationship_panel(df = df,
                                                                                                                                                              dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                              stage = "pre-log transformation",
                                                                                                                                                              transformed_covariates = character(0))}
                                                                     
                                                                                               transformed_covariates <- character(0)
                                                                                               dataset_log <- list()
                                                                                               
                                                                                               for (covariate in Variables) {if (!covariate %in% names(df)) {dataset_log[[covariate]] <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Available = FALSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Non_NA_n = NA_integer_,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Pre_log_skewness = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Log_transformed = FALSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Post_log_skewness = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Reason = "Covariate column not found")
                                                                                                                                                              next}
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                             if (!value_col %in% names(df)) {dataset_log[[covariate]] <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Available = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Non_NA_n = NA_integer_,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Pre_log_skewness = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Log_transformed = FALSE,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Post_log_skewness = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                                                        Reason = "Value column not found")
                                                                                                                                                              next}
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 plot_df_pre <- df %>%
                                                                                                                dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[covariate]]),
                                                                                                                              !is.na(.data[[value_col]]),
                                                                                                                              is.finite(.data[[covariate]]),
                                                                                                                              is.finite(.data[[value_col]]))
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 non_na_n <- nrow(plot_df_pre)
                                                                                                 pre_skewness <- safe_skewness(plot_df_pre[[covariate]])
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 plot_histogram(plot_df = plot_df_pre,
                                                                                                                dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                stage = "pre-log transformation")
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 plot_relationship(plot_df = plot_df_pre,
                                                                                                                   dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                   covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                   stage = "pre-log transformation")
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 should_log_transform <- is.finite(pre_skewness) && abs(pre_skewness) >= skew_threshold
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 if (should_log_transform) {df[[covariate]] <- log_transform_safe(df[[covariate]])
                                                                                                                            transformed_covariates <- c(transformed_covariates, covariate)
                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                            plot_df_post <- df %>%
                                                                                                                                            dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[covariate]]),
                                                                                                                                                          !is.na(.data[[value_col]]),
                                                                                                                                                          is.finite(.data[[covariate]]),
                                                                                                                                                          is.finite(.data[[value_col]]))
                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                            post_skewness <- safe_skewness(plot_df_post[[covariate]])
                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                            plot_histogram(plot_df = plot_df_post,
                                                                                                                                           dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                           covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                                           stage = "post-log transformation")
                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                            plot_relationship(plot_df = plot_df_post,
                                                                                                                                              dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                              covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                                              stage = "post-log transformation")
                                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                            dataset_log[[covariate]] <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                                       Covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                                                                       Available = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                       Non_NA_n = non_na_n,
                                                                                                                                                                       Pre_log_skewness = pre_skewness,
                                                                                                                                                                       Log_transformed = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                                       Post_log_skewness = post_skewness,
                                                                                                                                                                       Reason = paste0("Absolute skewness >= ", skew_threshold))} 
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 else {dataset_log[[covariate]] <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                  Covariate = covariate,
                                                                                                                                                  Available = TRUE,
                                                                                                                                                  Non_NA_n = non_na_n,
                                                                                                                                                  Pre_log_skewness = pre_skewness,
                                                                                                                                                  Log_transformed = FALSE,
                                                                                                                                                  Post_log_skewness = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                  Reason = paste0("Absolute skewness < ", skew_threshold))}}
                                                                                               
                                                                                               if (dataset_name %in% panel_datasets) {plot_histogram_panel(df = df,
                                                                                                                                                           dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                           stage = "post-log transformation",
                                                                                                                                                           transformed_covariates = transformed_covariates)
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                      plot_relationship_panel(df = df,
                                                                                                                                                              dataset_name = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                              stage = "post-log transformation",
                                                                                                                                                              transformed_covariates = transformed_covariates)}
                                                                                               
                                                                                               transformation_log[[dataset_name]] <<- dplyr::bind_rows(dataset_log)
                                                                                               
                                                                                               return(df)})
                                       
                                       transformation_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(transformation_log)
                                       
                                       Transformed <- transformation_table %>%
                                                      dplyr::filter(Log_transformed == TRUE) %>%
                                                      dplyr::group_by(Dataset) %>%
                                                      dplyr::summarise(Log_transformed_covariates = paste(Covariate, collapse = ", "),
                                                                       n_log_transformed = dplyr::n(),
                                                                       .groups = "drop")
                                       
                                       if (isTRUE(export)) {output_xlsx <- file.path(output_dir, "log-transformed_covariates.xlsx")
                                       
                                       if (file.exists(output_xlsx)) {file.remove(output_xlsx)}
                                       
                                                                      writexl::write_xlsx(x = list(Transformation_log = transformation_table,
                                                                                                   Transformed = Transformed),
                                                                                          path = output_xlsx)}
                                       
                                       return(list(Datasets = Datasets_out,
                                                   Transformation_log = transformation_table,
                                                   Transformed = Transformed))}
```

# Covariate selection
```{r covariate selection}
addSF <- function(Data) {st_as_sf(Data,
                                  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                                  crs = crs(Population),
                                  remove = FALSE)}

Datasets <- lapply(Datasets, addSF)

Variables <- c("Population", "Malaria", "Urbanization", "Consanguinity", "EFI", "RDI", "Counselling", "Prevention")

Datasets <- lapply(Datasets, function(df) {idx <- match(c("Population count", "Plasmodium falciparum incidence (per 1,000 population)", 
                                                          "Degree of urbanization", "Consanguinity (%)", "Ethnic Fractionalization Index", 
                                                          "Religious Diversity Index", "Counselling availability", "Prevention program availability"), names(df))
                                           keep <- !is.na(idx)
                                           names(df)[idx[keep]] <- Variables[keep]
                                           df})

# Retain necessary variables & data entries with complete covariate data
TestingD <- Datasets
TestingD <- lapply(TestingD, function(Data) {Data %>%
                                             dplyr::select(ADM0, geo_admin0, 
                                                           ADM1, geo_admin1, 
                                                           ADM2, geo_admin2, 
                                                           geometry, 
                                                           total, count, value, longitude, latitude, 
                                                           all_of(Variables)) %>%
                                             filter(if_all(all_of(Variables), ~ !is.na(.x)))})

# Identify covariate interactions
Interactions <- function(dataset, dataset_name, vars) {var1 <- vars[1]
                                                       var2 <- vars[2]
                                                       
                                                       interaction_name <- paste(var1, var2, sep = ":")
                                                       interaction_column <- paste(var1, var2, sep = "_x_")
                                                       model_formula <- as.formula(paste0("value / 100 ~ ", var1, " * ", var2))
                                                       
                                                       tryCatch({model <- glm(model_formula,
                                                                              data = dataset,
                                                                              family = binomial(link = "logit"))
                                                       
                                                                 coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
                                                                 interaction_row <- grep(":", rownames(coefs), value = TRUE)
                                                                 
                                                                 if (length(interaction_row) == 0) {return(NULL)}
                                                                 
                                                                 p_value <- coefs[interaction_row, "Pr(>|z|)"]
                                                                 
                                                                 tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                        Var1 = var1,
                                                                        Var2 = var2,
                                                                        Interaction = interaction_name,
                                                                        Interaction_Column = interaction_column,
                                                                        P_Value = p_value,
                                                                        Significant = p_value < 0.05)},
                                                                 error = function(e) {tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                             Var1 = var1,
                                                                                             Var2 = var2,
                                                                                             Interaction = interaction_name,
                                                                                             Interaction_Column = interaction_column,
                                                                                             P_Value = NA_real_,
                                                                                             Significant = NA)})}

SignInteractions <- imap_dfr(TestingD, ~ map_dfr(combn(Variables, 2, simplify = FALSE),
                                                 Interactions, dataset = .x, dataset_name = .y)) %>%
                    filter(Significant == TRUE) %>%
                    arrange(Dataset, P_Value)

# Add significant covariate interactions as new covariates
Addition <- function(dataset, 
                     dataset_name,
                     significant_table) {dataset_interactions <- significant_table %>%
                                                                 filter(Dataset == dataset_name)

                                         if (nrow(dataset_interactions) == 0) {return(dataset)}

                                         for (i in seq_len(nrow(dataset_interactions))) {var1 <- dataset_interactions$Var1[i]
                                                                                         var2 <- dataset_interactions$Var2[i]
                                                                                         interaction_column <- dataset_interactions$Interaction_Column[i]
                                                                                         
                                                                                         dataset <- dataset %>%
                                                                                                    mutate("{interaction_column}" := .data[[var1]] * .data[[var2]])}
                     dataset}

TestingD <- imap(TestingD, ~ Addition(dataset = .x, dataset_name = .y, significant_table = SignInteractions))

# Univariable logistic regression model per covariate & rank models by predictive power [Pseudo_r2]
Univariable <- function(Data, dataset_name) {# Define dataset-specific covariates
                                             Covariates <- c(Variables, names(Data)[str_detect(names(Data), "_x_")])
                                             
                                             # Null model fitted on the full dataset
                                             NullModel <- glm(cbind(count, total - count) ~ 1, data = Data, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
                                             
                                             model_results <- map_dfr(seq_len(5), function(i) {# Extract 80% of rows per Monte Carlo iteration
                                                                                               Subset <- sample(seq_len(nrow(Data)), size = floor(0.8 * nrow(Data)), replace = FALSE)
                                                                                               Trainset <- Data[Subset, ]
                                                                                               map_dfr(Covariates, function(j) {Formula <- as.formula(paste("cbind(count, total - count) ~", j))
                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                tryCatch({# Model fitted on training subset
                                                                                                                                          SModel <- glm(Formula, data = Trainset, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                          # Model fitted on full dataset
                                                                                                                                          FullModel <- glm(Formula, data = Data, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                          tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                 Iteration = i,
                                                                                                                                                 Covariate = j,
                                                                                                                                                 ResponseVariable = "Count",
                                                                                                                                                 Deviance = deviance(FullModel),
                                                                                                                                                 NullDeviance = deviance(NullModel),
                                                                                                                                                 AIC = AIC(FullModel),
                                                                                                                                                 r2 = cor(FullModel$fitted.values,
                                                                                                                                                          Data[["count"]] / Data[["total"]],
                                                                                                                                                          use = "complete.obs")^2,
                                                                                                                                                 Pseudo_r2 = cor(SModel$fitted.values,     
                                                                                                                                                                 Trainset[["count"]] / Trainset[["total"]],
                                                                                                                                                                 use = "complete.obs")^2,
                                                                                                                                                 Parameters = length(coef(FullModel)) - 1)}, 
                                                                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                          error = function(e) {tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                                                                      Iteration = i,
                                                                                                                                                                      Covariate = j,
                                                                                                                                                                      ResponseVariable = "Count",
                                                                                                                                                                      Deviance = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                      NullDeviance = deviance(NullModel),
                                                                                                                                                                      AIC = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                      r2 = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                      Pseudo_r2 = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                                                                      Parameters = NA_real_)})})})
                                             # Summarise across Monte Carlo iterations
                                             model_results %>%
                                             group_by(Dataset, Covariate, ResponseVariable) %>%
                                             summarise(Deviance = first(na.omit(Deviance)),
                                                       NullDeviance = first(na.omit(NullDeviance)),
                                                       AIC = first(na.omit(AIC)),
                                                       r2 = first(na.omit(r2)),
                                                       Pseudo_r2 = mean(Pseudo_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                       Parameters = first(na.omit(Parameters)),
                                                       .groups = "drop") %>%
                                             mutate(DevianceReduction = Deviance / NullDeviance) %>%
                                             arrange(Dataset, desc(Pseudo_r2)) %>%
                                             group_by(Dataset) %>%
                                             mutate(Rank = row_number()) %>%
                                             ungroup()}

UnivariableRank <- imap_dfr(TestingD, ~ Univariable(Data = .x, dataset_name = .y))
UnivariableRank

# Assess covariate multicollinearity [& Retain highest-ranking covariate among highly correlated pairs]
Multicollinearity <- function(Data,
                              dataset_name) {# Dataset-specific covariates
                                             Covariates <- c(Variables, names(Data)[str_detect(names(Data), "_x_")])
                                             
                                             # If fewer than 2 covariates, no correlation filtering is possible
                                             if (length(Covariates) < 2) {filtered_rank <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                                                           filter(Dataset == dataset_name, 
                                                                                                  Covariate %in% Covariates)
                                             
                                                                          return(list(Dataset = Data,
                                                                                      RetainedCovariates = Covariates,
                                                                                      RemovedCovariates = character(0),
                                                                                      HighCorrelations = tibble(),      
                                                                                      UnivariableRank = filtered_rank))}
                                             # Correlation matrix
                                             Correlations <- Data %>%
                                                             st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                                             dplyr::select(all_of(Covariates)) %>%
                                                             cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
                                             
                                             AllCorrelations <- as.data.frame(as.table(Correlations)) %>%
                                                                as_tibble() %>%
                                                                rename(Covariate_1 = Var1,
                                                                       Covariate_2 = Var2,
                                                                       Correlation = Freq) %>%
                                                                filter(as.character(Covariate_1) < as.character(Covariate_2)) %>%
                                                                mutate(Dataset = dataset_name, AbsCorrelation = abs(Correlation)) %>%
                                                                dplyr::select(Dataset, Covariate_1, Covariate_2, Correlation, AbsCorrelation) %>%
                                                                arrange(desc(AbsCorrelation))
                                             
                                             # Identify highly correlated pairs
                                             HighCorrelations <- which(abs(Correlations) >= 0.8 & lower.tri(Correlations), arr.ind = TRUE)
                                             
                                             if (nrow(HighCorrelations) == 0) {filtered_rank <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                                                                filter(Dataset == dataset_name,
                                                                                                       Covariate %in% Covariates)
                                             
                                                                               return(list(Dataset = Data,
                                                                                           RetainedCovariates = Covariates,
                                                                                           RemovedCovariates = character(0),
                                                                                           AllCorrelations = AllCorrelations,
                                                                                           HighCorrelations = tibble(),
                                                                                           UnivariableRank = filtered_rank))}
                                             
                                             CorrelatedCovariates <- tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                            Covariate_1 = rownames(Correlations)[HighCorrelations[, 1]],
                                                                            Covariate_2 = colnames(Correlations)[HighCorrelations[, 2]],
                                                                            Correlation = Correlations[HighCorrelations]) %>%
                                                                     mutate(AbsCorrelation = abs(Correlation)) %>%
                                                                     arrange(desc(AbsCorrelation))
                                             
                                             # Retain covariate per pair with higher pseudo r2
                                             ranking_table <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                              filter(Dataset == dataset_name) %>%
                                                              dplyr::select(Covariate, Rank, Pseudo_r2)
                                             
                                             RetainedCovariates <- Covariates
                                             RemovedCovariates <- character(0)
                                             
                                             for (i in seq_len(nrow(CorrelatedCovariates))) {cov1 <- CorrelatedCovariates$Covariate_1[i]
                                                                                             cov2 <- CorrelatedCovariates$Covariate_2[i]
                                                                                             
                                                                                             # Skip pair if one has already been removed
                                                                                             if (!(cov1 %in% RetainedCovariates) || !(cov2 %in% RetainedCovariates)) {next}
                                                                                             
                                                                                             rank1 <- ranking_table %>%
                                                                                                      filter(Covariate == cov1) %>%
                                                                                                      pull(Rank)
                                                                                             
                                                                                             rank2 <- ranking_table %>%
                                                                                                      filter(Covariate == cov2) %>%
                                                                                                      pull(Rank)
                                                                                             
                                                                                             pseudo1 <- ranking_table %>%
                                                                                                        filter(Covariate == cov1) %>%
                                                                                                        pull(Pseudo_r2)
                                                                                             
                                                                                             pseudo2 <- ranking_table %>%
                                                                                                        filter(Covariate == cov2) %>%
                                                                                                        pull(Pseudo_r2)
                                                                                             
                                                                                             # Remove weaker covariate
                                                                                             if (rank1 > rank2) {remove_covariate <- cov1} 
                                                                                             else if (rank2 > rank1) {remove_covariate <- cov2} 
                                                                                             
                                                                                             RetainedCovariates <- setdiff(RetainedCovariates, remove_covariate)
                                                                                             RemovedCovariates <- c(RemovedCovariates, remove_covariate)}
                                             
                                             RemovedCovariates <- unique(RemovedCovariates)
                                             Data_filtered <- Data %>%
                                                              dplyr::select(-any_of(RemovedCovariates))
                                             
                                             # Filter univariable ranking table
                                             UnivariableRank_filtered <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                                         filter(Dataset == dataset_name, Covariate %in% RetainedCovariates) %>%
                                                                         arrange(Rank)
                                             
                                             return(list(Dataset = Data_filtered,
                                                         RetainedCovariates = RetainedCovariates,
                                                         RemovedCovariates = RemovedCovariates,
                                                         AllCorrelations = AllCorrelations,
                                                         HighCorrelations = CorrelatedCovariates,
                                                         UnivariableRank = UnivariableRank_filtered))}

MulticollinearityResults <- imap(TestingD, ~ Multicollinearity(Data = .x, dataset_name = .y))

# Assess covariate multicollinearity via VIF analysis
VIF <- function(Data,
                dataset_name) {# Get covariates retained after correlation filtering
                               Covariates <- MulticollinearityResults[[dataset_name]]$RetainedCovariates
                               Covariates <- Covariates[Covariates %in% names(Data)]
                                     
                               # If fewer than 2 covariates, no correlation filtering is possible
                               if (length(Covariates) < 2) {vif_table <- tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                Step = 0,
                                                                                Covariate = Covariates,
                                                                                VIF = NA_real_,
                                                                                Removed = FALSE,
                                                                                Reason = "Fewer than 2 covariates")
                                      
                                                             rank_filtered <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                                              filter(Dataset == dataset_name,
                                                                                     Covariate %in% Covariates)
                                                             
                                                             Data_filtered <- Data %>%
                                                                              dplyr::select(ADM0, geo_admin0,
                                                                                            ADM1, geo_admin1,
                                                                                            ADM2, geo_admin2,
                                                                                            total, count, value,
                                                                                            longitude, latitude,
                                                                                            all_of(Covariates), geometry)
                                                             
                                                             return(list(Dataset = Data_filtered,
                                                                         RetainedCovariates = Covariates,
                                                                         RemovedCovariates = character(0),
                                                                         VIF = vif_table,
                                                                         UnivariableRank = rank_filtered))}
                               
                               # Ranking table used to break ties
                               ranking_table <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                filter(Dataset == dataset_name) %>%
                                                dplyr::select(Covariate, Rank, Pseudo_r2)
                               
                               RetainedCovariates <- Covariates
                               RemovedCovariates <- character(0)
                               VIFHistory <- list()
                               step <- 1
                               
                               # Iteratively remove worst VIF covariate
                               repeat {if (length(RetainedCovariates) <= 1) {break}
                                 
                                       Formula <- as.formula(paste("cbind(count, total - count) ~", paste(RetainedCovariates, collapse = " + ")))
                                       
                                       vif_result <- tryCatch({Model <- glm(Formula, data = Data, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
                                       
                                                               car::vif(Model)}, error = function(e) {return(NULL)})
                                       
                                                               # If VIF fails, do not remove all covariates
                                                               if (is.null(vif_result)) {VIFHistory[[step]] <- tibble(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                                      Step = step,
                                                                                                                      Covariate = RetainedCovariates,
                                                                                                                      VIF = NA_real_,
                                                                                                                      Removed = FALSE,
                                                                                                                      Reason = "VIF failed; covariates retained") 
                                                               break}
                                       # Convert VIF output to table
                                       if (is.matrix(vif_result)) {vif_table <- as.data.frame(vif_result) %>%
                                                                                rownames_to_column("Covariate") %>%
                                                                                as_tibble() %>%
                                                                                mutate(VIF = ifelse("GVIF^(1/(2*Df))" %in% names(.),
                                                                                                    `GVIF^(1/(2*Df))`, GVIF)) %>%
                                                                                dplyr::select(Covariate, VIF)} 
                                       else {vif_table <- tibble(Covariate = names(vif_result), VIF = as.numeric(vif_result))}
                                       
                                       vif_table <- vif_table %>%
                                                    mutate(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                           Step = step,
                                                           AbsVIF = abs(VIF)) %>%
                                                    left_join(ranking_table, by = "Covariate")
                                       
                                       max_vif <- max(vif_table$VIF, na.rm = TRUE)
                                       
                                       # Stop if all VIFs are acceptable
                                       if (is.na(max_vif) || max_vif <= 5) {VIFHistory[[step]] <- vif_table %>%
                                                                                                  mutate(Removed = FALSE,
                                                                                                         Reason = "All VIF values acceptable") 
                                       break}
                                       
                                       # Choose highest VIF covariate to remove
                                       remove_covariate <- vif_table %>%
                                                           arrange(desc(VIF), desc(Rank)) %>%
                                                           slice(1) %>%
                                                           pull(Covariate)
                                       
                                       VIFHistory[[step]] <- vif_table %>%
                                                             mutate(Removed = Covariate == remove_covariate,
                                                                    Reason = ifelse(Removed,
                                                                                    paste0("Removed because VIF > ", 5),
                                                                                    "Retained at this step"))
                                       
                                       RetainedCovariates <- setdiff(RetainedCovariates, remove_covariate)
                                       RemovedCovariates <- c(RemovedCovariates, remove_covariate)
                                       
                                       step <- step + 1}
                               
                               RemovedCovariates <- unique(RemovedCovariates)
                               
                               VIFTable <- bind_rows(VIFHistory) %>%
                                           dplyr::select(Dataset, Step, Covariate, VIF, Rank, Pseudo_r2, Removed, Reason)
                               
                               # Filter ranking table
                               UnivariableRank_vif <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                      filter(Dataset == dataset_name, Covariate %in% RetainedCovariates) %>%
                                                      arrange(Rank)
                               
                               # Filter dataset
                               Data_filtered <- Data %>%
                                                dplyr::select(ADM0, geo_admin0, ADM1, geo_admin1, ADM2, geo_admin2, 
                                                              total, count, value, longitude, latitude, all_of(RetainedCovariates), geometry)
                               
                               return(list(Dataset = Data_filtered,
                                           RetainedCovariates = RetainedCovariates,
                                           RemovedCovariates = RemovedCovariates,
                                           VIF = VIFTable,
                                           UnivariableRank = UnivariableRank_vif))}

VIFResults <- imap(TestingD, ~ VIF(Data = .x, dataset_name = .y))

TestingD <- map(VIFResults, "Dataset")
UnivariableRank <- map_dfr(VIFResults, "UnivariableRank")

# Multivariable logistic regression model [with backwards stepwise AIC-based selection]
Multivariable_AIC <- function(Data,
                              dataset_name) {# Get retained covariates after VIF filtering
                                             retained_covariates <- UnivariableRank %>%
                                                                    filter(Dataset == dataset_name) %>%
                                                                    pull(Covariate) %>%
                                                                    unique() %>%
                                                                    as.character()
                                             
                                             # Keep only covariates present in the dataset
                                             retained_covariates <- retained_covariates[retained_covariates %in% names(Data)]
                                             
                                             # If no covariates remain, return NULL model output
                                             if (length(retained_covariates) == 0) {return(list(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                                Model = NULL,
                                                                                                Formula = NA_character_,
                                                                                                CoefficientTable = tibble(),
                                                                                                SignificantTerms = character(0),
                                                                                                MainEffects = character(0),
                                                                                                FinalCovariates = character(0)))}
                                             
                                             # Identify retained main effects and retained interaction columns
                                             retained_interaction_columns <- retained_covariates[str_detect(retained_covariates, "_x_")]
                                             retained_main_effects <- setdiff(retained_covariates, retained_interaction_columns)
                                             
                                             # Retain interaction terms from SignInteractions only if:
                                             # 1. interaction was significant in this dataset
                                             # 2. both parent covariates were retained
                                             # 3. corresponding interaction column exists in the dataset
                                             
                                             retained_interactions <- SignInteractions %>%
                                                                      filter(Dataset == dataset_name) %>%
                                                                      mutate(Parent_1 = Var1,
                                                                             Parent_2 = Var2,
                                                                             Interaction_Column = paste(Var1, Var2, sep = "_x_")) %>%
                                                                      filter(Parent_1 %in% retained_main_effects,
                                                                             Parent_2 %in% retained_main_effects,
                                                                             Interaction_Column %in% names(Data),
                                                                             Interaction_Column %in% retained_covariates) %>%
                                                                      pull(Interaction_Column) %>%
                                                                      unique()
                                             
                                             # Multivariable model covariate input
                                             final_covariates <- unique(c(retained_main_effects, retained_interactions))
                                             final_covariates <- final_covariates[final_covariates %in% names(Data)]
                                             
                                             if (length(final_covariates) == 0) {return(list(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                                             Model = NULL,
                                                                                             Formula = NA_character_,
                                                                                             CoefficientTable = tibble(),
                                                                                             SignificantTerms = character(0),
                                                                                             MainEffects = character(0),
                                                                                             FinalCovariates = character(0)))}
                                             
                                             # Build model formula
                                             formula_str <- paste("cbind(count, total - count) ~", paste(final_covariates, collapse = " + "))
                                             model_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)
                                             
                                             # Fit full model and perform backwards AIC selection
                                             Model <- tryCatch({MASS::stepAIC(glm(model_formula, data = Data, family = binomial(link = "logit")),
                                                                              trace = FALSE, direction = "backward")}, 
                                                               error = function(e) {NULL})
                                             
                                             if (is.null(Model)) {return(list(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                                              Model = NULL,
                                                                              Formula = formula_str,
                                                                              CoefficientTable = tibble(),
                                                                              SignificantTerms = character(0),
                                                                              MainEffects = character(0),
                                                                              FinalCovariates = final_covariates))} 
                                             
                                             # Extract coefficient table
                                             coef_table <- summary(Model)$coefficients
                                             
                                             CoefficientTable <- as.data.frame(coef_table) %>%
                                                                 rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
                                                                 as_tibble() %>%
                                                                 mutate(Dataset = dataset_name) %>%
                                                                 dplyr::select(Dataset,
                                                                               Term,
                                                                               Estimate,
                                                                               `Std. Error`,
                                                                               `z value`,
                                                                               `Pr(>|z|)`)
                                             
                                             # Extract significant terms after backwards AIC
                                             SignificantTerms <- CoefficientTable %>%
                                                                 filter(Term != "(Intercept)",
                                                                        `Pr(>|z|)` <= 0.05) %>%
                                                                 pull(Term)
                                             
                                             MainEffects <- SignificantTerms[!str_detect(SignificantTerms, "_x_")]
                                             
                                             # Return outputs
                                             list(Dataset = dataset_name,
                                                  Model = Model,
                                                  Formula = formula(Model) %>% deparse() %>% paste(collapse = " "),
                                                  CoefficientTable = CoefficientTable,
                                                  SignificantTerms = SignificantTerms,
                                                  MainEffects = MainEffects,
                                                  FinalCovariates = final_covariates)}

MultivariableResults <- imap(TestingD, ~ Multivariable_AIC(Data = .x, dataset_name = .y))

# Dataset clean-up post covariate selection
Selection <- function(Data,
                      dataset_name) {# Final significant covariates from selected multivariable model
                                     final_covariates <- MultivariableResults[[dataset_name]]$SignificantTerms
                                     final_covariates <- final_covariates[final_covariates %in% names(Data)]
                                     
                                     # All candidate covariates originally considered
                                     candidate_covariates <- c(Variables, names(Data)[str_detect(names(Data), "_x_")])
                                     candidate_covariates <- candidate_covariates[candidate_covariates %in% names(Data)]
                                     
                                     # Remove only non-significant candidate covariates
                                     non_significant_covariates <- setdiff(candidate_covariates, final_covariates)
                                     
                                     Data %>%
                                     dplyr::select(-any_of(non_significant_covariates))}

Datasets2 <- imap(Datasets, ~ Selection(Data = .x, dataset_name = .y))
```

```{r cov selection export}
export_multicollinearity_results <- function(MulticollinearityResults,

                                                                                                    openxlsx::freezePane(wb, univ_rank_sheet, firstRow = TRUE)
                                                                                                    openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, univ_rank_sheet, cols = 1:ncol(univ_rank), widths = "auto")}
```

# Vizualize
```{r plot}
make_overview_map <- function(df) {breaks <- unique(c(0, 0.5, 1, 3, 5, 7, 10,
                                                      seq(20, ceiling(max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10, by = 10)))

                                   pal <- leaflet::colorBin(reverse = TRUE,
                                                            na.color = "transparent",
                                                            palette = viridisLite::viridis(n = length(breaks),
                                                                                           option = "F",
                                                                                           end = 0.9),
                                                            domain = c(min(df$value, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                       max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                            bins = breaks)
                                   
                                   df %>%
                                   leaflet::leaflet() %>%
                                   leaflet::addProviderTiles("CartoDB.PositronNoLabels") %>%
                                   leaflet::addCircleMarkers(radius = 6,
                                                             color = ~pal(value),
                                                             stroke = FALSE,
                                                             fillOpacity = 0.8) %>%
                                   leaflet::addLegend(position = "bottomright",
                                                      pal = pal,
                                                      opacity = 0.8,
                                                      values = c(min(df$value, na.rm = TRUE),
                                                                 max(df$value, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                      title = "β-thalassaemia<br> carrier prevalence (%)")}

Visual_Overviews <- purrr::imap(Datasets2, ~ make_overview_map(.x))

output_dir <- "Output/"

                                                                                     paste0(dataset_name, "_Visual_Overview.html"))

                                                            htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget = map, file = output_file, selfcontained = FALSE)
                                                            message("Saved: ", output_file)})

rm(make_overview_map, Visual_Overviews)
```
