# Variograms
```{r variogram dat}
VariogramR <- function(data,
                       title,
                       output_file = NULL,
                       output_file_no_text = NULL,
                       min_points = 5,
                       width_mm = 200,
                       height_mm = 150,
                       dpi = 300) {# Prepare data
                                   data_v <- data %>%
                                             sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
                                             dplyr::select(value, longitude, latitude) %>%
                                             dplyr::filter(!is.na(value),
                                                           !is.na(longitude),
                                                           !is.na(latitude),
                                                           is.finite(value),
                                                           is.finite(longitude),
                                                           is.finite(latitude))
                                   
                                   if (nrow(data_v) < min_points) {warning("Skipping variogram: fewer than ", min_points, " valid points for ", title)
                                                                   return(list(plot_created = FALSE,
                                                                               reason = "Too few valid points",
                                                                               variogram = NULL,
                                                                               variogram_model = NULL))}
                                   
                                   # Convert to SpatialPointsDataFrame
                                   sp::coordinates(data_v) <- ~ longitude + latitude
                                   
                                   # Maximum observed coordinate distance
                                   max_dist <- max(stats::dist(data_v@coords), na.rm = TRUE)
                                   cutoff_dist <- max(1, max_dist / 3)
                                   
                                   # Empirical variogram
                                   variogram_emp <- gstat::variogram(value ~ 1, data_v, cutoff = cutoff_dist)
                                   
                                   if (nrow(variogram_emp) == 0 || all(is.na(variogram_emp$gamma))) {warning("Skipping variogram: empirical variogram could not be estimated for ", title)
                                                                                                     return(list(plot_created = FALSE,
                                                                                                                 reason = "Empirical variogram unavailable",
                                                                                                                 variogram = variogram_emp,
                                                                                                                 variogram_model = NULL))}
                                   
                                   # Fit Matérn model
                                   variogram_model <- tryCatch({gstat::fit.variogram(variogram_emp, gstat::vgm("Mat", fit.kappa = TRUE))},
                                                               error = function(e) {warning("Variogram model fitting failed for ", title, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
                                                                                    NULL})
                                   
                                   draw_variogram <- function(show_text = TRUE) {graphics::par(family = "Times New Roman",
                                                                                               ps = 10,
                                                                                               cex = 1,
                                                                                               cex.axis = 1,
                                                                                               cex.lab = 1,
                                                                                               cex.main = 1,
                                                                                               mar = if (show_text) c(4.5, 4.8, 3.2, 1.2) else c(2, 2, 0.5, 0.5))
                                     
                                                                                 graphics::plot(variogram_emp$dist,
                                                                                                variogram_emp$gamma,
                                                                                                ylim = c(0, max(variogram_emp$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)),
                                                                                                col = "black",
                                                                                                pch = 16,
                                                                                                cex = 0.8,
                                                                                                axes = FALSE,
                                                                                                ann = FALSE,
                                                                                                xlab = "",
                                                                                                ylab = "",
                                                                                                main = "")
                                                                                 
                                                                                 if (show_text) {graphics::axis(1)
                                                                                                 graphics::axis(2)
                                                                                                 graphics::box()
                                                                                                 graphics::title(xlab = "Distance between locations",
                                                                                                                 ylab = "β-thalassaemia carrier prevalence semivariance",
                                                                                                                 main = title)} 
                                                                                 else {graphics::axis(1, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                       graphics::axis(2, labels = FALSE)
                                                                                       graphics::box()}
                                                                                 
                                                                                 if (!is.null(variogram_model)) {model_line <- tryCatch({gstat::variogramLine(gstat::vgm(psill = variogram_model$psill[2],
                                                                                                                                                                         model = "Mat",
                                                                                                                                                                         range = variogram_model$range[2],
                                                                                                                                                                         kappa = variogram_model$kappa[2],
                                                                                                                                                                         nugget = variogram_model$psill[1]),
                                                                                                                                                              maxdist = max(variogram_emp$dist, na.rm = TRUE))},
                                                                                                                                        error = function(e) NULL)
                                                                                 
                                                                                 if (!is.null(model_line)) {graphics::lines(model_line$dist,
                                                                                                                            model_line$gamma,
                                                                                                                            type = "l",
                                                                                                                            lwd = 1.2)}
                                                                                 
                                                                                 graphics::abline(h = variogram_model$psill[1], col = "#4d43a9", lwd = 1)
                                                                                 graphics::abline(v = variogram_model$range[2], col = "#BE1D54", lwd = 1)
                                                                                 graphics::abline(h = variogram_model$psill[1] + variogram_model$psill[2], col = "#439fa9", lwd = 1)
                                                                                 
                                                                                 if (show_text) {graphics::legend("topright",
                                                                                                                  legend = c("Nugget", "Range", "Sill"),
                                                                                                                  col = c("#4d43a9", "#BE1D54", "#439fa9"),
                                                                                                                  lty = 1,
                                                                                                                  bty = "n",
                                                                                                                  cex = 1,
                                                                                                                  text.font = 1)}}}
                                   
                                   export_tiff <- function(file, show_text = TRUE) {if (!is.null(file)) {if (!dir.exists(dirname(file))) {dir.create(dirname(file), recursive = TRUE)}
                                     
                                                                                                         grDevices::tiff(filename = file,
                                                                                                                         width = width_mm,
                                                                                                                         height = height_mm,
                                                                                                                         units = "mm",
                                                                                                                         res = dpi,
                                                                                                                         pointsize = 10,
                                                                                                                         family = "Times New Roman",
                                                                                                                         compression = "lzw")
                                                                                                         
                                                                                                         tryCatch({draw_variogram(show_text = show_text)},
                                                                                                                  finally = {if (grDevices::dev.cur() > 1) {grDevices::dev.off()}})}}
                                   export_tiff(output_file, show_text = TRUE)
                                   export_tiff(output_file_no_text, show_text = FALSE)
                                   
                                   invisible(list(plot_created = TRUE,
                                                  reason = NA_character_,
                                                  variogram = variogram_emp,
                                                  variogram_model = variogram_model))}

# Export variograms
run_variograms_for_datasets <- function(Datasets2,
                                        output_dir = "Output/Variograms/",
                                        min_points = 5) {if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)}
  
                                                         safe_filename <- function(x) {gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", x)}
                                                         
                                                         variogram_results <- list()
                                                         variogram_summary <- list()
                                                         
                                                         for (dataset_name in names(Datasets2)) {df <- Datasets2[[dataset_name]]
                                                                                                 dataset_safe <- safe_filename(dataset_name)
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 output_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(dataset_safe, "_Variogram_all.tiff"))
                                                                                                 output_file_no_text <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(dataset_safe, "_Variogram_all_no_text.tiff"))
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 result <- VariogramR(data = df,
                                                                                                                      title = paste0("Empirical variogram | ", dataset_name),
                                                                                                                      output_file = output_file,
                                                                                                                      output_file_no_text = output_file_no_text,
                                                                                                                      min_points = min_points)
                                                                                                 
                                                                                                 variogram_results[[paste0(dataset_name, "_All")]] <- result
                                                                                                 variogram_summary[[paste0(dataset_name, "_All")]] <- tibble::tibble(Dataset = dataset_name, 
                                                                                                                                                                     Subset = "All",
                                                                                                                                                                     Plot_created = result$plot_created,
                                                                                                                                                                     Reason = result$reason,
                                                                                                                                                                     Output_file = output_file,
                                                                                                                                                                     Output_file_no_text = output_file_no_text,
                                                                                                                                                                     Nugget = if (!is.null(result$variogram_model)) {result$variogram_model$psill[1]} 
                                                                                                                                                                              else {NA_real_},
                                                                                                                                                                     Partial_sill = if (!is.null(result$variogram_model)) {result$variogram_model$psill[2]} 
                                                                                                                                                                                    else {NA_real_},
                                                                                                                                                                     Range = if (!is.null(result$variogram_model)) {result$variogram_model$range[2]} 
                                                                                                                                                                             else {NA_real_},
                                                                                                                                                                     Kappa = if (!is.null(result$variogram_model) && "kappa" %in% names(result$variogram_model)) {result$variogram_model$kappa[2]} 
                                                                                                                                                                             else {NA_real_})}
                                                         
                                                         variogram_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(variogram_summary)
                                                         
                                                         openxlsx::write.xlsx(variogram_summary, file = file.path(output_dir, "Variogram_summary.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
                                                         
                                                         invisible(list(Results = variogram_results, Summary = variogram_summary))}

Variogram_results <- run_variograms_for_datasets(Datasets2 = Datasets2,
                                                 output_dir = "Output/Variograms/",
                                                 min_points = 5)

rm(VariogramR, run_variograms_for_datasets, Variogram_results)
```
